snang ①bar gyur te/ gang la 'od kyis reg pa de dag thams cad lus dang sems bde bar 'gyur ba thugs brtse ba'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis bstan du gsol/ de la bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu dag legs par nyon la shin tu ②yid la zung ④shig dang / khyed la dgrol zhing bshad par bya'o/ /'di nas lho phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong 'das pa'i pha rol na sangs rgyas kyi zhing mi mjed ces bya ba yod de/ de na sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rig pa dang / zhabs su ldan pa / bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen ④pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ ston pa rgyal ba/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba 'khor mang pos yongs su bskor (denas/ 'khor mang po thams cad la thabs mkhas pa chen po drin lan bsab pa'i mdo sde ston cing / sems can ⑥thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i don gyi phyir/ sems can thams cad kyi zug rngu rtsa nas gdon pa'i phyiral/ sems thog ma pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dag byang chub las phyir mi ldog cing brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad mthar phyin pa'i theg pa gcig la dgod pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' ②chen po rnams myur du mngon par byang chub cing lasangs rgyas kyi drin lan bsab pa'i phyir/ sems can thams cad kyis drin rtsi ⑩ba dran par bya ba'i phyir/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral ⑪ba'i phyir/ so so'i 8skye bo dag pha ma la sri zhu bya bar 'dod pa'i phyir 'od 'di snang bar gyur pa yin no/ /de'i tshe 'khor de'i nang na yi byang chub sems dpa' 76—269

'khor mang po'i nang na①/ gtso bo dang ston par gyur pa/ stong phrag bcu snyed stan las langs par gyur nas/ bla gos phrag pa ②gcig tu gzar ③nas/pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs ④te/ bcom ldan 'das de dul 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi byin gyi rlabs ⑥kyis bdag cag rnams mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams der mchi zhing de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur bgyi ba dang / thabs mkhas pa chen po sangs rgyas nyadrin lan ⑧bsab pa'i mdo sde dam pa nyan cing mchi bar byin gyis ⑨brlab tu gsol/ de nas sangs rgyas des byang chub sems dpa' de ⑩rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu dag khyed mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams der phyin nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de la mchod cing bkur ste yibya ba dang / shin tu phrad dka' ba'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / sangs rgyas shākya thub pa ni bskal pa grangs med pa bye ba khrag khrig gi bar du shin tu spyad dka' ba spyad ni/pas/ snying rje chen pos 0smon lam 'di skad ces btab bo/ /gal te mngon par sangs rgyas pa na/ 'jig rten gyi khams sdig pa can/ ri dang / shang shong dang / gyo mo dang / gseg skem dang / tsher ma la sogs pa 8yod pa'i gnas su sems can dag kyang nyon mongs pa dang bcas pa / mtshams med pa lnga dang / mi dge ba bcu rdzogs par spyod 0pa'i gnas der mngon par sangs rgyas te/ phan pa dang bde ba'i don du sdug bsngal thams cad yongs su bcad de/ bde ba thams cad dang ldan par byas nas chos kyi sku yongs su rdzogs shing / lhag ma ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das par gyur cig ces smon lam btab bo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 8des 76—270

thog ma de skad ces smon lam btab pas/ khyed rnams 'jig rten gyi khams der phyin nas/ ji ltar sangs rgyas nyid gshegs pa dang / ji ltar sangs rgyas nyid bzhugs pa dang 'dra bar sems par ①bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyis tshig 'thun par bcom ldan 'das kyi ②bka' bzhin du bgyi'o zhes gsol nas/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag re re yang ①'khor byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong snyed kyis yongs su bskor te/ mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang na ba der dong ste/ de dag 'jig rten gyi khams gang dang gang du phyin par 'jig rten gyi khams de dag rjornam pa drug tu g.yos te/ 'od zer chen po yang kun du snang bar gyur/ steng gi bar snang las lha rnams kyis ⑤me tog man dā ⑥ra ba dang / man dā mer ba chen po yang char bzhin niphab bo/ /'od zer chen pos snang bar byas shing rdzu 'phrul gyis 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag ponyekyang g.yos so//de ma yin pa gzhan yang lha rdzas kyi rol mo tshad med pa brgya stong snyed kyang steng gi bar snang la ma tu )dkrol bar rang zer bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' de dag nyurtebya rgod srungs pa'i ri ga la ba der de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar lhags nas zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ sangs rgyas la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de bzhin du phyogs mtshams bzhi dang /steng dang / 'og gi phyogs dang / phyogs bcu nas lhags pa'i byang chub sems dpa' tsochen po thams cad kyis 0so so nas 'khor brgya stong grangs med pa dang bcas te/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der lhags nas/ mchod pa dang bkur sti ④byas/ bstod ⑩pa byas nas thams cad kyis ⑩mgrin gcig 76—271

tu tshigs su bcad pa brgya stong snyed kyis bcom ldan 'das la yongs su bstod do//de ltar sangs rgyas la bstod ①nas kyang phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de'i tshe mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyang ②yongs su dag par gyur te/ ri khrod ①khrod dang ske/ ri chen po dang / chung ngu dang / gtsang ④po dang / chu klung ⑤dang /mtshe'u dang / rdzing dang / lteng ka dang / shang shong dang / ngam grog dag med cing / de na gnas pa'i sems can rnams kyang 'od kyis snang bar byas pas sangs rgyas gang na ba der lhags teyi/ dga' zhing mgu ba'i sems kyis thal mo sbyar ba btud nas mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mig mi 'dzums ⑦par chags pa'i (8)yid kyis lta zhing 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 7'od zer phyir 'dus par tsomadzad de/ 'od zer de dag gis sku la lan bdun bskor nas dbu'i spyi gtsug tu nub par gyur to/ /de ltar gyur pa kun dga' bos mthong nas 'khor mang po thams cad kyang hunyathe tsom hu)skyes par sems kyis rab tu shes pas / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzad pa thabs mkhas pa mngon par bstan pa dang ske/ phyis hunyem 'ongs pa'i skye bo dag gi shes rab kyi mig skye ④ba dang / so so'i skye bo thams cad sred pa'i chu klung las rgal 8zhing pha rol tu phyin pas bde ba la dgod pa dang / so so'i skye bo dag la 8pha ma dang / slob dpon dang /bla ma'i drin rtsi ba dran zhing shes par bya ba'i phyir stan 0las langs nas/ gos tshags su bcos nas bla gos 8phyogs gcig tu byas nas lipus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga gu sa la btsugs nas thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag kun dga' bos sangs rgyas kyi zhabs 0'bring na mchis nas ༷ ge'adzum pa mdzad pa mthong ste 'di la nges 76—272

par dgongs pa ni mnga' na 'khor mang po'i the tsom ①gyi dra ba bcad ②pa'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis bstan du gsol/ sangs rgyas kyis bshad du gsol/thabs mkhas pa chen po sangs rgyas drin lan bsab pa'i mdo las gleng gzhi'i le'u zhes bya ste dang po'o③// //de'i tshe de'i dus na 'khor mang po 'dus pa der rin po che sna bdun las grub ④pa'i pad ma'i stisdong po dngul las byas/ 'dab ⑥ma ni gser las byas/gzhi ni rin po che shel las byasal/ mu tig gi dra bas kun du brgyan pa gcig sa ⑧de nyid nas byung khyabar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa bzhugs pa las bzhengs nas pad mo de la skyil mo krung bibacas nas bzhugs so//de la bzhugs hunyem thag tu yongs su dag pa'i sku mngon par bstan to/ /sku de las tshulam rgyud lnga'i lus kyi tshogs bstan/ lus kyi tshogs re re la yang gzugs tha dad pa rnam pa khri brgya (nyestong snyed bstan to/ /gzugs rnam pa de 0re re la ⑫yang sku'i tshogs /stobargya stong snyed bstan/ sku'i tshogs de dag ho 1re re la yang gang gā'i klung bzhi'i bye ma snyed kyi sku'i tshogs snyed nyusnyebastan to/ /gang gā'i klung bzhi'i bye ma snyed kyi sku'i tshogs de dag re re la yang gling bzhi'i rdul phra rab snyed kyi sku'i tsotshogs bstan to( sta/ /rdul phra rab snyed ༷ )kyi sku'i tshogs de dag re re la yang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul phra rab snyed kyi sku'i tshogs bstan to/ /rdul phra rab snyed na kyi sku'i tshogs de dag re re la yang phyogs bcur phyogs re rer yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi rdul phra rab snyed 0kyi sku'i tshogs bstan nas/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyis klas 0pa/76—273

chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa snyed kyi sems can gyi lus kyi tshogs mngon par bstan to①/ / de'i tshe ②de bzhin gshegs pas de snyed kyi lus kyi tshogs mngon par bstan nas kun dga' bo dang phyogs bcu nas ③'dus shing tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang /'khor mang po rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu dag deng de bzhin gshegs pas thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis yang dag pa'i tshig gang yin pa de ④bka' stsal par bya'o/ /chos la tshig tu brjod ⑤pa med mod ⑥kyi de bzhin gshegs pas thabs mkhas pa'i dbang gis mtshan ma dang / ming med pa'i chos la ming dang mtshan mar bstan par bya'o/ /'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa ⑦ni thog mar skyes shing 'khor bar 'khor ba'i tshe bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rdul phra rab snyed kyi lus kyi tshogs rnam pa tha dad pa de dag thams cad rdzogs par myong ste/ de ltar lus kyi tshogs de dag kun myong bas na/ sems can thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i pha mar ma gyur pa med/ de bzhin gshegs pas kyang sems can gyi pha mar ma gyur pa med de/ pha mar gyur pa thams cad kyi phyir rgyun du shin tu spyad dka' ba yang spyad/ shin tu gtang dka' ba zhu yan lag gi dam pa mgo dang / mig dang / klad ①rgyas dang /yul dang / grong khyer dang / chung ma dang / bu pho dang / bu mo dang ⑩/ban rmenyeglang dang / rta dang / rin po che sna bdun gyi shing rta dang / theg pa dang ske/ gos dang / zas dang / skom dang / mal cha dang / nad kyi rkyen rtsi dang ske/ dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad gang yang ma btang 8ba med do/ /shin tu 'bad pa'i brtson 'grus kyis tshul khrims bsrungs pa tsodang / sbyin pa byas pa 76—274

dang ske/ mang du thos pa dang / bsam gtan bsgoms pa dang / shes rab spyad ①pa nas spyod dka' ②ba thams cad spyad de / skyo ba dang / ngal ba med cing rgyun mi 'chad par brtson 'grus su 'bad pa yang pha ma la sri zhu bya ba dang /drin shes pa dang / drin lan bsab pa dang / sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dgod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sngon gyi smon lam yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang / de ltar na sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi bka' drin chen po yod par shes par bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje chen pos sems can yongs su mi gtong ba dang / rtag par shin tu thabs mkhas pas khams gsum pa'i srid pa nyi shu rtsa lngar gnas pa'i sems can thams cad la bskal pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bar du mnyam snyoms pa'i byams pa bsgoms shing / btang snyoms dang ldan pa'i thabs mkhas pas ④spyod de/ sems can thams cad stong pa nyid du rtogs pa dang / chos stong pa nyid dang / phung po lnga stong pa nyid du rtogs ⑧shing phyir mi nur ba dang / mi 'bying ⑥ba dang / mi rgod pa stong pa nyid du yang dag pa'i mtshan nyid la thabs mkhas pas bsgom par bya ba dang / theg pa gsum mi spong zhing chub par slob pa'i thabs la (bemakhas pas shin tu zab mo'i spyod yul dam pa spyad pa la thabs mkhas par bya ba'i phyir/ chos kyi mtshan nyid la shin tu gsal bar rtogs te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams thog ma dang tha ma'i bar du gcig ma yin par rtogs shing chud kyang ⑧so so'i skye bo dag ni myos shing bslad pas gdung ba gsum gyis yongs su gdungs te/ sdug bsngal gyi mtshor nub par gyur to / /phyin ci stilog bzhis bsgribs ⑩pas zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos la phyin ci 76—275

log tu gyur to/ /mi bden pa ①kun tu rtogs ②pas bdag med pa la bdag tu lta(ba / mi rtag pa la rtag par lta/ mi bde ba la bde bar lta/ mi gtsang ba la gtsang bar lta zhing skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi bas gzir te skad cig tu mi rtag pas sgrib ④pa lnga dang / kun nas glags ⑤pa bcus kun du glags yite/ srid pa gsum du 'khor zhing skye shi thog ma dang tha ma med pa myong bar gyur to/ /de bas na de bzhin gshegs pas ci dang cir 'phrod pa bzhin sde snod gsum dang / mdo sde dgu nas mdo sde bcu gnyis kyi bar du rnam par phye rjozhing bstan to/ /so so'i 'dod pa bzhin mdo sde mang po gsungs so/ /tshig la chags pa kha cig bdag ni 'di kho nas chog ste/ mya ngan las 'das pa thob ces 'dzin pa yang yod do/ /de yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sngon gyi thugs rje chen po'i smon lam gyi shugs kyis laphyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na las 'thun pa thams cad bsdus so/ /de ltar las 'thun pa kun 'dus pa ⑨'khor mang po'i dkyil 'khor der tsodam pa'i chos tsomado sde gsungs par dgongs te/ gzugs brnyan (3gyi chos nam du yang rgyun mi 'chad cing so so'i skye bo thams cad bde ba chen po thob par mdzad do/ /de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa 'dul zhing ston pa yang dus las mi yol bar shesanyunye/ dus las mi yol bar mya ngan las 'da'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams kha cig tu de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad ces bya ba dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ ston pa rgyal ba/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhes grags so/ /skabs kha cig tu ni dga' ldan gnas su 76—276

gshegs nas lha rnams kyi ston pa mdzad do/ /skabs kha cig tu ni dga' ldan gnas nas babs te/ 'dzam bu'i gling du sku tshe lo brgyad cur ①bzhugs pa ③yang ston to/ /de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyang bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /las kyi ②rnam par smin pa yang bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /sems can gyi bsam pa ④yang bsam gyis mi khyab bo / /bsam gtan gyi ting nge 'dzin yang bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /klu'i mthu yang bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bsam gyis mi khyab pa ste/sems can thams cad kyis sangs rgyas kyi ⑤thugs la dgongs pa shes par 'dod na sems can dbang po zhan pa tha ma'i bar du yang kun shes par mdzad do/ /sems can thams cad las gang yang sangs rgyas mthong bar 'dod na de ma thag tu mthong bar mdzad do/ /gal te mthong bar mi mdzad na mig sngar bab kyang mi mthong ngo / /de bas na nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dag lha'i mig gi mngon par shes pa yod kyang mthong bar mi nus so/ /de ma yin pa gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyis 'od zer chen po bkye yinas srid pa'i rtse mo man chad mtshams med pa'i sems can dmyal ba yan chad snang bar mdzad kyang gang 'dul ṅge'i skal ba ⑦dang ldan pas ⑧ni mthong bar 'gyur/ gang skal ba yidang mi ldan pas ⑫ni mig sngar bab kyang mi mthong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa skabs kha cig tu ni ched du yiskul ba mdzad/ skabs kha 8cig tu ni cang mi gsung bas na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ shin tu dpag par dka' ba/shin tu shes shing rtogs par dka' na/ ji ltar khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa la spyod 0dka' ba shin tu zab mo dri ba la 0spobs par gyur/ khyod kyis zhus pa 76—277

'di ni yang dag par sems can thams cad la byams shing snying brtse ①ba yin te/ngan 'gro gsum gyi lam bkag nas lha dang mi'i lam btod pa yin no/ /kun dga' bo ngas da 0khyod la pha ma la sri gzhu bya ba'i spyad rjodaka' ba ⑤mdo tsam zhig bstan par byas ༅legs par nyon la yid la zung ①shig⑧ / de nas ⑨bcom ldan 'das kyis kun dga' bo dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag ⑩dang / 'khor mang po rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sngon byung ba bskal pa tshad med pa mtha' yas grangs med pa 'das pa'i pha rol na yul bā rā ṇa sīr tunyesangs rgyas rnam par gzigs zhes bya ba 8de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa / bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul tsoba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ ston pa rgyal ba/ 'jig rten gyi gtso bo/ lha dang mi'i ston pa 'jig rten du byung ngo / /sangs rgyas de'i sku 8tshe'i tshad kyang bskal pa chung ngu nyi shur bzhugs so/ /dam pa'i chos kyang bskal pa chung ngu nyi shur gnas so / /gzugs brnyan gyi chos kyang bskal pa chung ngu nyi shur gnas so/ /gzugs brnyan gyi chos la 8spyod pa'i tshe mi'i rgyal po rā dza ⑩zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ yul bā rā ṇa sī la dbang sgyur ro/ /rgyal po de la 0btsun mo ni nyi khri yod/ blon po ni bzhi stong snyed yod(3/ bal gyi glang po che yang lnga brgya yod / rgyal phran drug cu tsol dbang / grong khyer brgyad brgya zhig yod/ rgyal po de la rgyal sokye bu gsum yod de/ gsum char ⑥yang rgyal phran re re byed do/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na yul bā rā ṇa sī'i rgyal po de mkhas shing tsoshes rab dang ldan te / rtag tu yang drang ba'i ( nyechos kyis yul gyi srid 'dzin pas gang yang gtams kū76—278

las chad ces bya ba med do/ /rgyal po'i bsod nams dang yon tan gyi mthus char chu dus las mi yol te/ lo tog rgyun du legs pas de na gnas pa'i mi rnams kyang bde skyid do/ /de'i tshe na bā rā ṇa sī'i rgyal po de la blon po nag ①po sgra gcan zhes bya ba zhig yod do/ /blon po sgra gcan rgyal po la 'khus nas dmag rnam bzhi bshams pa la ②'di lta ste/ bal 0glang gi tshogs dang / shing rta'i tshogs dang / rta'i tshogs dang ④/ dpung bu chung gi tshogs bshams nas bā rā ṇa sri'i rgyal po la brgal nas rgyal po'i srog bcad do/ /de ltar rgyal po bsad nas kyang dmag gi tshogs rnam pa ⑤bzhi bkye nas mtha'i rgyal phran rgyal (7bu rab kyang bsad do/ /de nas rgyal bu 'bring po yang phab nas mtha'i rgyal phran rgyal bu tha chungs kyi ⑦thog tu dmag drang bar (8)bshams so/ /rgyal bu tha chungs ⑨de ngo mtshar du gzugs byad bzang la/ 'phags par mdzes shing rang bzhin gyis dge ba/ dul ba/ 'dzum zhing smra ba smra'o cog kyang phan pa'i don du smra zhing 'gyur gyi gnod pa med pa/ rtag tu drang po'i chos kyis yul gyi srid 'dzin te/log pas mi 'tsho bas yul gyi ⑩mi rnams kyang bde skyid la dar ba/ longs spyod dang nor 7rin po cher ldan pa/ bang mdzod gang ba/ rgyal po de'i yon tan la kun gyis bsngags ⑩shing bstod pa/ bar snang gi lha dang / 'jig rten gyi lha thams cad kyis kyang dga' zhing bkur ba/ de'i tshe na rgyal po de la rgyal bu su sha de ba zhes bya ba gcig pu zhig yod de/ shin tu yid gzhungs shing gsal ba / byams pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ sbyin pa la dga' ba/ lus kyi mdog gser du 'dug pa/ gnas bdun mnyam par gang ba/ skyes bu'i tsomatshan rdzogs par ldan pa/ lo bdun lon pa zhig yod pa de la/ yab rgyal po yang 76—279

shin tu byams shing sdug par sems so/ /de'i tshe na pho brang srung ba'i lha zhig rgyal po de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rgyal po mkhyen tam/ blon po sgra gcan 'khus nas yul srid phrogs te rgyal po yab kyang bkrongs①/ dmag gi tshogs bzhi yang bkye nas/ rgyal po gcen gnyis kyang srog gi dbang po dang phral te/dmag gi tshogs rnams ring po mi thogs par 'dir phyin na rgyal po ci'i phyir srog bskyabs (kyeshing gud du mi 'gro/ de'i tshe ①rgyal po des de skad byasmras pa thos nas lus kyi ba spu (9kun zing zhes byed de/ lus kyang 'dar nas yi mug cing mya ngan gyis sems gdungs te/ sa la 'gre zhing brgyal yibar gyur ⑦nas ring zhig lon pa dang / cung zad sangs te dal gyis nam mkha'i lha la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'di ltar smra ba'i skad ni yod la gzugs ni mi snang ba khyod ci yin/ smras pa'i tshig 'di yang dag par bden nam/ lhas smras pa bdag ni rgyal po'i pho brang srung ba'i lha yin te/ rgyal po khyod shes pa dang ldan zhing bsod nams dang yon tan du phurabacas pas yi)drang po'i chos kyis 7yul srid 'dzin te/ de bas na bdag gis sngar hu7smras pa yin te/ sdug bsngal gyis nyon mongs par ma gyur par myur du byol zhing 'gro ba'i rigs so/ /de nas rgyal po de pho brang du zhugs 8nas da (1)ni bdag yul gzhan zhig tu 'gro dgos so snyam du bsams so yang 'di snyam du bsams so/ /yul pha rol tu 'gro ba'i chalam gnyis yod do8/ /lam nye bar zhugs na ni zhag bdun gyis yul 8pha rol tu phyin par 'gyur/ lam ring por zhugs na ni zhag bcu bzhis phyin par 'gyur bas/ ci nas lam nye bar 'gro'o snyam bsams nas zhag bdun gyi rgyags dang chas te/ pho brang gi phyi rol tu phyin pa dang / phyir pho brang gi nang du log nas rgyal bu 0su sha de ba pang du 76—280

blangs te mig mi 'dzums ①par lta zhing dngangs ②pa ltar ②langs nas phyir yang 'dug go/ /de'i tshe na btsun mos de ltar mi bde zhing skrag pa ltar gyur pa mthong nas rgyal po la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rgyal po chen po/ ci'i slad du 'jigs shing ④spag pa lta bu'i gzugs ston cing sku la yang rdul gyis phyigos pa lta bu / skra yang 'dzings te/ dbugs kyang mi bde ste/ yul stor la thug pa'am/mdza' sdug pa dang bye ba'am/ dgra sdang ba dang phrad pa lta bu dang / bkra mi shis pa'i mtshan ma dag gda' ba 'di ci lags bstan du gsol/ rgyal pos smras pa / kho bo ci nyes pa khyod kyis 0shes pa ma ⑦yin gyis ⑧ma smra zhig btsun mos gsol pa/ bdag dang rgyal por lus gzugs gnyis kyang sems gcig ste/dper na bya'i 'dab ma gnyis sam/ lus kyi rkang pa gnyis sam/ mgo'i mig gnyis sam/ de dang 'dra na ci'i slad du bdag la gsang ste mi gsung sti/ rgyal pos btsun mo la smras pa/ khyod ⑩mi shes sam/ blon po sgra gcan ngan sems skyes nas rgyal po la 'khus te yab rgyal po yang bgrongs 7te gcen rgyal bu gnyis kyi 8srog gi bar chad byas nas da ltar dmag dang chas te nga la rgol du 'ong bas8/kho bo yul gzhan du 'byol du 'gro zhes smras nas rgyal bu dge don pang du blangs te lam du zhugs so/ /de nas btsun mo yang rgyal po'i phyir 'brangs te song ngo / /de'i tshe rgyal po mya ngan gyis non te/ yid 'khrugs nas zhag bcu bzhi'i lam du zhugs pas lam yang nor te/ lam de yang bgrod dka' zhing rtswa ④yang rtsub/rtswa 8chu tsam yang med de⑩/ zhag du ma zhig song song ⑩ba las rgyags kyang chad dom/ /thog ma gsang ste rgyal po gcig pu 'gro bar byas nas zhag bdun gyi rgyags las kyang ma brdzangs pa las lam yang nor/ mi gsum gyis kyang zos te/ zhag 76—281

bcu bzhi'i lam du zhugs pas da dung lam ring zhig yod pa las rgyags kyang stichad nas de'i tshe rgyal po dang btsun mos skad phyung ②nas ngus so/ /kyi hud kyi hud re sdug thog ma btsas chanas da tsam gyi bar du 'di 'dra ba ma myong ba da 'dir myong bar gyur te/ da 'dir sdug cing phongs so zhes zer te lag pas mgo la brdabs ④so/ /sa la 'gre zhing lus la rdul gyis gos nas tshig 'di skad du smre sngags 'don to/ /bdag cag gis tshe snga ma la sdig pa mi dge ba'i las ci zhig byas/ 'on te pha ma dang dgra bcom pa bsad dam/ 'on te dam pa'i chos la skur pa btab bam/ 'on te 'thun pa'i dge 'dun gyi dbyin ⑤bgyis sam / 'on te rngon pa dang / nya pa byas sam/ 'on te srang dang bre bcos te pha rol la yiphrog rlom byas sam/ 'on te dge 'dun gyi nor la spyod spyod dam/ci byas na 'di 'dra ba'i sdug bsngal myong bar gyur ces ⑦de skad smre zhing cung duzad bstir ni skyudagras slebs na srog gi bar chad nges par 'byung / lam du zhugs nas 'gror ni bkres ⑩pa dang skom pas nyen nas/ srog la bab tu cha'o⑩//rgyal po dang btsun mo de lta bu'i sdug bsngal gyis 0nyen te skad phyung ste ngus pa dang sa la 'gyel nas brgyal tsobar gyur to/ /de nas ring zhig lon pa dang sangs nas 'di snyam du gsum char lhan cig tu 'di kho tsonar 'chi bar 'gyur gyis8ske/ btsun mo bsad la bdag dang bu'i srog thar bar bya'o snyam bsams nas ral gri 0phyung ste btsun mo bsad ⑩par bshams pa dang / rgyal bu dge don gyis rgyal po'i lag pa nas bzung ste/ da ⑤ltar ci zhig mdzad dgongs zhes gsol to/ /yab rgyal pos mig nas mchi mas gang bzhin du rgyal bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyod kyi ma btsun mo dam pa bsad la khyod kyi hunyesrog gso snyam mo/ /76—282

gal te ma bsad kyang ①/ rang 'chi bar 'gyur te/ kho bo ni 'chi 'am gson yang rung na bu khyod kyi srog gso ba'i phyir khyod kyi ma btsun mo ②bsad ③snyam mo/ /de nas rgyal bu dge don gyis yab rgyal po ④la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gal te btsun mo bsad par gyur na de'i sha la bdag mi 'tshal te/ gang na yang ma'i sha la bu za ba mi srid pas bdag kyang 'chi bar 'gyur na yab (9rgyal po ci'i slad du bdag bkum ste/ pha ma'i srog thar bar mi mdzad/ yab rgyal pos de skad ces ⑥smras pa thos nas mod la 'khams 4)te 'gyel nas sa la 'gre zhing rgyal bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyod kho bo'i mig dang 'dra na su zhig rang gi mig phyung ste za bar byed/ kho bo ni shi'ang bla 6)bas bu mi gsod do/ /bu bsad de (7sha za mi nus so/ /de nas rgyal bu dge don gyis yang yab rgyal po la 'di skad ces gsol to / /gal te yab yum gyis bdag bkum na sha khrag kyang ring po mi thogs par rul sungs nas dgos ⑩pa ma mchis par 'gyur te/ bdag gis yigasol ba gcig cig ma gnang na byams pa'i yab yum ma lags pas bdag gi yid dang mi 'gal bar mdzad du gsol/ de nas yab rgyal pos sras rgyal bu la khyod kyi yid dang mi 'gal bar bya bas ci gsol ba rnams myur du smros shig ces bsgo 8ba dang ske/ rgyal bu dge don gyis yab rgyal po la 'di skad ces lcagegasol to/ /yab yum gyis bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du nyin re re 8zhing bdag gi lus las ⑫sha rgya ma gsum gsum bcad de/ cha gnyis ni yab yum la 'bul0/ cha gcig ni bdag rang ⑩'tshal na lus srog gi zungs 8su 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal pos kyang rgyal bus gsol pa bzhin du gnang nas nyin gcig bzhin sha rgya ma gsum gsum bcad de/ cha gsum du bgos nasam/ cha gnyis ni rgyal po dang btsun 76—283

mo za/ cha gcig ni rgyal bu rang za ste/ lus dang srog gi zungs 0)byas nas lam du zhugs te song song ②ba las zhag gnyis kyis (gyiyul pha rol ma slebs par rgyal bu'i lus kyi sha zad de rus pa'i tshigs dang chu ba tsam zhig 'brel te srog gi lhag ma tsam zhig lus nas sa la 'gyel to/ /de nas rgyal po dang btsun mos rgyal bu pang du blangs nas skad chen po phyung nas cho nges chen po ④btab ste (ge'adi skad ces smras so/ /nged gnyis kyis ma rig pas (7khyod kyi sha zos te khyod 'di lta bu'i na tsha ba'i (7)sdug bsngal myong bar gyur la/ lam yang da dung ring bas/ khyod kyi ⑧lus kyi sha ni zad de/ da lani lhan cig tu gnas 'dir ro gzhag 0go/ /de nas rgyal bu dge don gyis skad chung ngus yab rgyal po la 'di skad ces gsol to7//da hurte'adi nas pha rol tu zhag gcig tsam gyi 3nyelam las ma lus te/ bdag ni g.yo zhing bskyod ④mi nus pas srog 'dir 'dor ro/ /rgyal po dang btsun mo ni mi ma rabs snyingan pa ltar lhan cig tu gnas 'dir ro gzhag go ma gsung tsheshig /bdag la byams shing thugs brtse ⑩bar dgongs na bdag gis gnye bsams pa dang mi 'gal bar mdzad du gsol/ da dung yang bdag gi nyu7rus pa'i gseb na sha ci yod pa ma lus par btogs ( )la yul pha rol tu gshegs su gsol/ de nas rgyal pos yang rgyal bus gsol pa bzhin du tshigs dang rus pa'i gseb na sha ci yod pa zad par (stobatogs nas cha gsum du bgos te/ cha ci gnyis ni rgyal po dang btsun mos zos/ cha gcig ni rgyal bu rang gis 0zos te/ rgyal po dang btsun mo yang lam du zhugs nas dong ngo / /rgyal bu dge don langs nas 'greng bzhin du ④rgyal po dang btsun mo song ba la blta'os/ /rgyal po dang btsun mo gnyis skad phyung ri rinyanas ngu zhing ( 7song nas rgyal bu dge don gyis sa mig gis mi sod 76wa 284

kyi bar du rgyal po dang btsun mo la chags pa'i sems yo)kyis mig mi 'dzums par blta blta nas ring ②zhig lon pa dang phyir sa la 'gyel to/ /sha dang khrag gi dri bro bas phyogs bcu nas sbrang ma dang sha sbrang mang po 'dus nas rgyal bu yog pa tsam du lus la za zhing 'dzugs ①te sdug bsngal gyis gdungs so/ /de'i tshe na rgyal bu de srog gi lhag ma tsam zhig ma chad de skad phyung nas 'di skad ces smon lam du ④btab bo/ /bdag gi sngon gyi mi dge ba'i las rnams ni 'dis byang zhing zad par rgyur cig /deng slan chad (gemi bgyid do/ /bdag gi lus pha ma la phul te sbyin pa byas pas bdag gi pha ma snga ma (6)bas lhag pa'i bsod nams bcu gcig dang ldan te bde bar nyal ba dang / bde bar sad pa dang / mi lam ngan pa mi rmi ba dang / lhas srung ⑦ba dang / mis bkur (8)ba dang /zhal mchu dang / rkun po dang / dgra dang / rku lto (7byed pa med cing dus thams cad du bkra shis par shog shig /bdag gi lus lhag ma tsam sha khrag sbrang ma la byin pas thams cad du 'grangs 7shing tshim par gyur te bdag ma 'ongs pa'i dus na sangs rgyas su hu'egrub par shog shig /sangs rgyas su grub nas chos kyi sku thob nas kyang chos kyi skus thams cad kyi bkres phonyaskom pa'i mu ge dang skye shir 'khor ba'i nad lci ba 8sel bar shog shig /rgyal bus de skad ces 0smon lam btab pa na gnam sa yang rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ nyi ma yang 'od mi gsal bar gyur/ gcan gzan 7dang ri dgas rnams kyang skrag nas kun tu rgyug /rgya mtsho yang rab tu 'khrugs/ ri rab kyang 'gul zhing ldeg/sum cu rtsa gsum gnam gyi bar du yang rab tu g.yos so/ /de'i tshe brgya byin lha'i dbang pos 'dod pa'i khams kyi lha dag dang 'dzam bu'i gling dag tu babs 76—285

nas rgyal bu dge don bsdigs 6)pa'i phyir seng ge dang / stag dang / 'phar spyang la rdo sogs pa'i lus su sprul nas mig bgrad ②kha gdangs/ spu bsgrengs rjonas skad chen po'i nga ro phyung ste/ rgyal bu la mchong ba ⑤bzhin bsdigs so/ /de'i tshe rgyal bu dge don ⑥gyis gcan gzan lakhro bo de dag mthong nas kyang skad mi che bas 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyed rnams kho bo za 'dod na ci bder zo zhigan) /'di 'dra ba'i mthu rtsal gyis bsdigs ci dgos zhes bsgo'o⑨/ /de nas brgya byin lha'i dbang pos smras pa/ bdag cag ni ⑩seng ge'am gcan gzan 37ma yin gyis / brgya byin lha'i dbang po yin te khyod bgam zhing sad du 'ongs so/ /de'i tshe rgyal bus brgya byin lha'i dbang po mthong nas shin tu dga' mgu nyunyerangs par ④gyur to'on/ /de nas brgya byin gyis rgyal bu la ⑩smras pa/khyod kyis 3nyeshin tu gtong 3)dka' ba btang ste/ lus kyi sha khrag gis pha ma la bstabs pa 'di'i bsod nams kyis khyod bdud kyi rgyal po 'dod dam/ 'on te tshangs pa'i rgyal po 'dod dam/ lha'i dbang po'am/ mi'i rgyal po'am/'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po 'dod/ rgyal bus smras pa/ bdag ni bdud kyi ⑪rgyal po'am/ tshangs pa'am/ lha'i rgyal po'am/ mi'i rgyal po'am/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po gang yang mi 'dod de/ sems can thams cad rnam par grol bar bya ba'i phyir bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod do/ /brgya byin gyis smras pa/ khyod ni shin tu yang ( ze gti mug can zhig yin pa 'dra/bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni yun ring po nas shin tu dka' ba ( bstobasgrubs pas gdod rngo nya'agrub ce'o/ /khyod kyis shin tu sdug bsngal ba bzod dam nye/ rgyal bus smras pa/ gal te lcags kyi 'khor lo 'bar ba bdag ④76—286

gi spyi bo'i steng nas ①rgyun du 'khor yang sdug bsngal de tsam gyis bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog go/ /brgya byin gyis smras pa / khyod kyis smras pa stong pa 'di la su zhig yid ches par 'gyur/ de nas rgyal bus dam bcas nas smon lam 'di skad ces btab bo/ /gal te bdag gis smras pa'i latshig brdzun ①te/ lha'i dbang po bslus par gyur na bdag gi lus kyi rma 'di nam du yang 'tsho bar ma gyur cig /gal te smras pa'i ④tshig bden na/ bdag gi lus kyang sor chud cing khrag kyang 'o mar gyur cig ces smras ma thag tu lus kyi rma yang snga mkho (lde)bzhin sor chud de/ khrag kyang 'o mar gyur nas rgyal bu'i byad gzugs kyang snga ma (7bas lhag par bzang zhing sdug pa dang mdzes par gyur te langs nas lha'i dbang po'i rkang pa la mgo bos phyag byas so/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis rgyal bu (7)khyod legs so/ /shin tu legs so/ /shin tu dpa' ba'i brtson 'grus kyis gdon mi za bar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs par ⑧byang chub nyupar 'gyur ro/ /ring po 7mi thogs par bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pa na/ thog mar bdag gi ⑪don mdzad par gyur cig ces smras nas brgya byin lha'i dbang po yang nam mkha'i phyogs de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe yang (nyergyal po dang btsun mo yang rgyal po pha rol po de'i 8drung du phyin nas rgyal po des kyang rgyang ma nas bsu nas dgos pa'i yo byad yid bzhin du sbyar ro/ /de'i tshe rgyal po dang btsun mo des rgyal bu'i ④lus kyi sha khrag gis pha ma la ji ltar bstabs pa rgyal po de la zhib tu brjod pa dang / rgyal po des ji ltar gyur 8pa de dag thos nas rgyal bu des lus kyi (9sha khrag gis pha ma la bstabs hu —1pas sri zhu cher byas pa'i drin lan bsabs (nye76—287

nas / dmag rnam bzhi bshams nas rgyal po de dang yul bā rā ṇa sīr dmag drangs so/ /de'i tshe ①rgyal po de dmag rnam bzhi dang chas nas lam du zhugs te/rgyal bu dang bral ba'i gnas su phyin pa dang / 'di snyam du bdag gi bu ni gdon mi za bar 'di (kenyid du shi na bu'i rus pa tsam bsdus te phyir bdag gi yul du bkur (kye'o snyam du bsams ④nas skad phyung ⑤nas ngu zhing bu'i rus bu dusdud du song song ba las ⑦rgyang ma nas bdag gi bu ①lus kyi rma ⑨yang sos nas snga ⑩bas kyang rtsonyabazang zhing mdzes te drung du 'ongs so/ /de nas rgyal pos pang du blangs te khyod da dung gson nam ⑩zhes smras pa dang / rgyal bus ji ltar gyur pa/yab rgyal po dang btsun mo la smras so/ /rgyal po dang btsun mo rab tu dga' ste/thams cad ban 8glang la zhon nas phyir bdag gi yul du phyin pa dang / rgyal bu de'i bsod nams kyi hustemathus bdag gi yul yang phyir thob 8nas rgyal bu don grub rgyal por dbang bskur te rgyal por bcug go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis tsokun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ de'i tshe de'i dus na yab rgyal por gyur pa de gzhan zhig (1 yin snyam du khyod nyustesems na de de ⑩ltar mi blta'odu )/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/de'i tshe de'i dus na yab rgyal po de ni da ltar nga'i yab zas gtsang ma zhes bya bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na yum du gyur pa de ni gzhan zhig yin (nyasnyam du khyod sems na de de ltar mi blta ste(3/ de ni da ltar nga'i yum lha mdzes zhes bya ba yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal bu don grub ces bya bar gyur pa de gzhan zhig yin shu nyesnyam du khyod sems na de de ltar mi blta'o(ste/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal bu de ni da ltar shākya thub pa zhes bya ba nga yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na brgya byin lha'i dbang por gyur pa de ni ( snyed ltar kun shes tso kau ḍi n+ya na)zhes bya 76wa 288

ba yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis hu)pha ma la sri zhu byed pa'i le'u 'di bstan pa'i tshe 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de na byang chub sems dpa' khri phrag nyi shu snyed kyis (gyi'agro ba thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i don la mkhas pa'i tshig gi spobs pa thob par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' khri phrag bcu gnyis kyis mi skye ba'i chos la chos kyi ①bzod pa thob bo/ /gzhan yang phyogs bcu nas 'dus pa'i nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas 5rdul phra rab snyed ⑤kyis theg pa gnyis kyi ⑥sems spangs te theg pa gcig gis mthar (7phyin par gyur to/ /dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma rdul duphra rab snyed kyis 'bras bu dang po nas theg pa gnyis kyi ⑨'bras bu'i bar du thob par gyur to/ /lha dang mi brgya stong snyed ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed ⑩do/ /de ma yin pa lha dang / klu dang / yi dgas dang / lha ma yin dang / dri za dang /nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma lags pa la 0sogs pa'i tshogs 8mang po rnams la la ni bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed (snyenas nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi bar du sems bskyed par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis yikun dga' bo la bka' stsal pame/ byang chub sems dpa' dag gis sems can thams cad kyi ⑩don du pha ma la sri zhu bya ba'i phyir lus kyi sha dang hu khrag gis kyang pha ma la bstabs shing shin tu spyad dka' ba spyod pa ni 'di lta bu yin no/ /'khor mang po thams cad kyis sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa thos nas so so nas phan pa dang bde ba'i don rnyed de8/ dga' mgu charangs nas mgo bos phyag 'tshal te g.yas phyogs nas bskor ba byas nas phyir dong ngo / /thabs mkhas pa chen po sangs rgyas drin lan bsab pa'i mdo 76—289

las sri zhu'i le'u zhes bya ste gnyis pa'o①// // thabs mkhas pa chen po sangs rgyas drin lan bsab pa'i mdo/② bam po gnyis pa/ de'i tshe de'i dus na bcom ldan 'das ②'khor gyi dkyil 'khor mang po'i nang na ④nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis skar ⑤ma mang po zil gyis mnan pa lta bu'am / klu 'khyil pa'i 'ja' tshon ltar 'tsher zhing gsal ba la lta dun mig mi chags pa bzhin nam/ bsams na yid 'khrul ⑦pa tsam du 'od zer lham me/lhang nger bzhugs te/ dper mi bzod pa ni srin bu me khyer gyi du'od nyi ma shar ma thag tu mi snang ba'am/ nyi zla la 0'od zer brgya stong snyed ⑩yod kyang brgya byin gyi 7drung na sol phung lta bu'am/ brgya byin la 'od gsal 8ba yod kyang tshangs pa chen po'i 'od zer gyi drung na gyo mo'am/ gseg ma lta bu'am/ mtshan mo dang nor bu rin po che'i 'od du bsgrun pa tsam mamatso/ tshangs pa'i rgyal po chen po la ④'od zer dam pa brgya stong snyed yod pa'i 'od thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od zer gyi drung na sol ba'i phung po ltar gyur to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od zer gyi 8mdog gang gis phyogs bcu'i ⑩'jig rten gyi khams kun tu snang bar gyur to/ /de dag na gnas pa'i sems can dag la 'od zer des reg na dmus long ⑩ni mig gis gzugs mthong bar 'gyuratso / lus skur po ni lus rangs par 'gyurayi/ dbang po nyams pa rnams nu) ni dbang po tshang zhing yan lag dang nying lag dang ldan par 'gyur( nye/myos pa rnams ni dran pa phyir rnyed par 'gyuradu/ mdor na ji tsam du yid du mi 'ong ba thams cad dang bral te 'dod pa bzhin thob par 'gyur ro0/ /de'i tshe 76wa 290

'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de nyid du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bdun cu ①sted stan las langs nas sangs rgyas kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te lan brgya stong du bskor ②ba byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do①/ /thams cad kyis skad 'thun par tshigs su bcad pa brgya stong gis de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon par bstod 0pa byas pa la 'di lta ste④/ byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rtog med dbyangs dang / byang chub sems dpa' bde ba 'ba' zhig sems dang / byang chub sems dpa' dri ma med par grags pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' tshad med dbyangs rjodang /byang chub sems dpa' grags pa chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' gtsug phud 'od dang / byang chub sems dpa' brtan pa'i seng ge dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'ba' zhig rol dang / byang chub sems dpa' rtog pa spong ba dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' ye shes brtsegs dang / byang chub sems dpa' dge gnas blo gros dang / byang chub sems dpa' rab ⑦tu mtshan med dang /byang chub sems dpa' blo gros 'od zer dang / byang chub sems dpa' khro zhi ④blo gros dang / byang chub sems dpa' shin tu bsrung ⑨'gyur dang / byang chub sems dpa' dad pa btsan ⑩dang / byang chub sems dpa' me tog 'phags dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bde dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa'i shes rab las dang / byang chub sems dpa' ngo 'phral 'chad dang /byang chub sems dpa' bsam du med pa yidang / byang chub sems dpa' tshangs pa sbyin dang / byang chub sems dpa' rin chen las dang / byang chub sems dpa' lha'i me tog gnas dang / byang chub sems dpa' shin tu sems dang /76—291

byang chub sems dpa' dpag med chos dang / byang chub sems dpa' grags pa'i yid dang / byang chub sems dpa' spobs pa brtsegs dang / byang chub sems dpa' dbang phyug sgo dang / byang chub sems dpa' stobs bcu dang /byang chub sems dpa' stobs bcu 'chang dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa chen pos skyong dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'das pa med pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba rol dang / byang chub sems dpa' de na gnas dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' grangs med lha dang / byang chub sems dpa' ri rab 'od dang / byang chub sems dpa' rab tu ①phyi ba'i sdong po dang / byang chub sems dpa' rgyu las 'phags dang / byang chub sems dpa' gcig pu 'gro dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' gzi brjid 'phags dang / byang chub sems dpa' sde chen mkhas ②dang / byang chub sems dpa' ris skyob dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gsum 'dzin dang / byang chub sems dpa' ngo 'phral yod dang / byang chub sems dpa' grags pa brjod dang / byang chub sems dpa' nyi 'od chagasal dang / byang chub sems dpa' seng ge btsan ④dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' dus tshod rgyal po dang / byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' srid mngon ston dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'od rgyang gsal dang / byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i ri dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' srid len sbyin ⑤dang / byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba sbyin (yedang / byang chub sems dpa' rgyal mtshan mchog dang / byang chub sems dpa' dga' mgu rangs dang / byang chub sems dpa' brtson 'grus brtan dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'gribs med dang / byang chub 76—292

sems dpa' grags ldan dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'jigs med dang /byang chub sems dpa' ma chags lha ①dang / byang chub sems dpa' sgron ma chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten 'od dang / byang chub sems dpa' dam pa'i dbyangs dang / byang chub sems dpa' thabs chen stobs dang /byang chub sems dpa' mun nag sel ②dang / byang chub sems dpa' mnyam med phyogs la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyis sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar yi dam 'di skad bcas so/ /bdag cag rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu sangs rgyas kyi chos bsrung zhing phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu rgyas par bgyi zhing rgyun mi 'chad par bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bdag cag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od zer dam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mthong nas 'od zer de dag las sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab par ②yang thos par 'gyurasti/ chos de dag thos nas sems ⑤kyi sgrib pa dang bral te kun nas nyon mongs pa thams cad byang nas/ lha'i rin po che gser ltar sems rnam par dag par gyur pas ⑥thams cad gsal bar snang bar gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /bdag cag 9)gis phan pa dang / bde ba'i yon tan 'di lta bu nidran pas de bzhin gshegs pa la ston pa chen por ⑨'du shes skyes so//byams pa'i pha ma ⑩lta bu'i 'du shes skyes nas rtag tu sangs rgyas kyi bka' drin dran te sangs rgyas kyi ⑩bka' drin shes par bgyid do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/dam pa'i chos thos pas 8ring po tsomi thogs par byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug cing dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te sems can thams cad sgrol bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag kyang chos thos pas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 76—293

thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pas 'khor mang po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bdun cu ①po 'di dag yun ring po nas bskal pa grangs med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi ⑧rdul phra rab snyed kyi sngon rol na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gā'i ③klung gi bye ma ④ brgya stong ⑤sted kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi durdul phra rab snyed la bsnyen ⑦bkur byas te/ sangs rgyas de dag las rtag tu tshangs par spyod pa spyad ⑤cing rgyal ba de dag la mi skyo ba'i sems kyis mnyes par byas nas/byams pas bdag gi 0lus bsrungs te sangs rgyas kyi 0chos 'dzin cing snying rje chen pos rgyun du phyogs bcur thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i don byed do/ /sems can gang zhig tha ma shi kur byang chub sems dpa' de dag la gcig gi ming ngam / gnyis sam/ gsum mam/ bzhi nas bdun cu'i yibar du rdzogs ⑫par thos te/ de la srog phyogs skyabs su song na tshe 'phos ma thag tu gang na sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams su pad mo las rdzus te skye bar 'gyur zhing 'dod chags dang yongs su bral ba dang / mngal gyi gnas nas mi skye ba dang / mnam zhing btsog 8pa dang bral bar 'gyur te/ lus yongs su dag cing lus dri zhim pa dang / thams cad kyi ④yid du 'ong zhing bkur ste ⑫byed par 'gyur ro/ /kun gyi yid du 'ong zhing bkur sti tsobyas pas sems rab tu dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /sems rab tu dga' bas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pas sems can thams cad la byams pa dang snying rje chen po'i sems bskyed par 'gyur/ de ltar byams pa dang snying 76—294

rje'i sems bskyed pas 'gro ba ma lus pa la btang snyoms su mi gtong ①ba'i sems skye bar 'gyur/ gzhan yang sems can thams cad ②la phan pa dang bde bar 'gyur ba'i sems dang / bdag dang gzhan gyi ①don byed pa'i sems dang /sgrib pa dang / bar chad du 'gyur ba bsal ④ba'i sems dang / nyon mongs pa zhi bar byed pa'i sems dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsnyen cing rtag tu bkur ste byed pa'i sems dang / 'dun pa'i yid kyis ⑤chos nyan pa'i sems dang ske/ mi brjed par yid la byed 0cing don bzang po gzungs su 'dzin pa'i sems dang / nyung du thos la don mang du shes pa'i sems dang / mang du thos la don mi shes pa mi 'dod pa'i sems skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas yang dag pa nyid la dang ba'i sems dang / de bzhin nyid kyi don ⑦bden pa la dad pa'i sems skye bar 'gyur/ yang dag pa'i don bden pa la dad pa'i sems skyes pas ji ltar bstan pa bzhin du rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sems skye bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar bstan pa bzhin du rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sems skyes pas phyir mi ldog pa'i sems skye bar 'gyur/ de ltar phyir mi ldog pa'i sems skyes pas sems can de dag 0thams cad la mnyam snyoms pa'i gnyen po'i sems skye bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar bdag khams gsum pa'i srid pa nyi shu ⑨lngar skye bar mi dga' ba bzhin du gzugs yod pa dang / gzugs med pa dang / rkang bzhi dang / rkang mangs dang ⑩/ grog 0spur nas srog chags thams cad kyang de dang 'dra ste/ de bas na byang chub sems dpa' ni lus dang srog gi bar du stor yang pha rol po'i srog 'phrog pa'i las mi byed do/ /ji ltar bdag la nor rdzas dang / 'bru dang /gos dang / zas dang / skom dang / ban 8glang dang / shing rta dang /76—295

theg pa dang / yul dang / grong khyer dang / chung ma dang / bu dang / lus kyi yan lag gi bar du longs spyod rnams la srung zhing rim gro byed do/ /gzhan gyis khyer zhing 'phrog pa la mi dga' ba bzhin du sems can thams cad kyang de dang 'dra ste/ de bas na byang chub sems dpa' ni bdag gi lus dang srog stor kyang sems can rnams kyi nor dang / gos dang / zas dang / skom dang /longs spyod la 'phrog pa'i sems mi skyed do/ /ji ltar bdag gi gzugs dam pa sring mo'am/ chung ma'am/ slas la gzhan gyi ①mi rigs par ②byed mi 'dod pa de ③bzhin du sems can thams cad kyang de dang 'dra ste/ de bas na byang chub sems dpa' ni bdag gi lus dang srog stor kyang pha ④rol po'i gzugs dam pa la 'du shes ngan pa log pa'i sems mi skyed na mi rigs pa'i chos ngan pa lta ci smos / ji ltar bdag phra ma dang tshig rtsub po 'khrug par 'gyur ba la mi dga' ba bzhin du sems can rnams kyang de dang 'dra ste/ de bas na byang chub sems dpa' ni bdag gi lus dang srog yal yang brdzun ⑤du smra ba dang / phan tshun 'khrug pa'i tshig mi smra'o/ /ji ltar bdag rdo dbyug gis rdeg ⑥pa dang / lcag gis gzhu 9)ba dang / nan la 'bor ba la mi dga' ba bzhin du sems can thams cad kyang de dang 'dra ste/ de bas na byang chub sems dpa' ni bdag gi lus dang srog yal niyang rdo dbyug dang / lcag dang chad pas gcad pa'i las kyis sems can rnams la mi 'tshe'o6)/ /ji ltar bdag lcags sgrog dang / khong sgril dang / mtshon cha dang ⑩/ bzung yib dang / btags 8pa dang /bcing bas bcings pa'i husteganod pa rnams la mi dga' ba bzhin du sems can kun kyang de dang 'dra ste/ de bas na byang chub sems dpa' ni lus dang srog 76—296

yal yang lcags sgrog dang / khong sgril dang / bzung ①ba dang / bcing ba la sogs pa ②gnod pas ①'tshe bar mi byed do/ /ji ltar bdag gzhan gyis brnyas ④pa dang / dbang dang / drag shul byed pa dang / dbang rlom btsan byed bsnyems ④shing ngan du byed pa la mi dga' ba bzhin du sems can thams cad kyang de dang 'dra ste/ de bas na byang chub sems dpa' ni bdag gcig pu'i lus dang srog yal ⑥yang tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i mi rigs pas sems can la gnod pa mi byed do/ /ji ltar bdag la pha rol po ⑦gzhan gyis bkur ste ②byed cing mchod dam tshig snyan ⑨pas bstod na/ bdag bde ba ⑩la dga' ba ⑫bzhin du bdag kyang sems can rnams la gos dang / zas dang / skom dang /mal cha dang / nad kyi rkyen rtsi dang / bde ba'i yo byad thams cad kyis ⑩sbyin par byed do/ /gal te bdag gis las chen po zhig sgrub pa'amaX// sangs rgyas kyi phyir ram/ chos kyi phyir ram/ dge 'dun gyi phyir ram/ don sgrub 8pa las blos mi lcogs te don grub 8par ma gyur nas/ mi dga' zhing mya ngan gyis gdungs pa las mkhas pa blo dang ldan pa zhig gis bdag gis bsgrub pa'i don ma grub pas mi dga' zhing mya ngan byed par mthong na bdag la 'di skad zer ro/ /rigs kyi bu khyod mi dga' ba ma byed cig /khyod kyi don grub pa'i grogs bya ste/ste/don yid bzhin du bsgrub ⑩par bya'o/ /zhes zer na de la rab tu dga' ba'i sems (3skye bar 'gyur te/ de bas na bdag gis sems can la phan pa dang bde ba'i don du bsgrub pa'i las kyi ⑩grogs bya'o/ /ji ltar bdag la rgyal po dang ske/ rkun po dang chu'am/ mes gnod par 'gyur ram/ blon po la sogs pas / bzung ngam/ btags sam/ bcings na mi dga' ba'i mya ngan gyis 76—297

gdungs par gyur pa las mkhas pa blo dang ldan pa zhig gis bdag de ltar mya ngan gyis gdungs pa mthong na/ snyan pa sgra'i tshig gis bdag la khyed ①mya ngan ma byed cig /khyod kyi ②phyir kho bos rgyal po'am/ blon po chen po la gsol ba btab ste/ gal te na nor gsug ①sbyin pa'am/ thabs rnam pa sna tshogs kyis ci dunas kyang khyod mi bde ba'i sdug bsngal las thar bar bya'o zhes zer na/bdag gis tshig de thos pa tsam gyis ④sems dga' bar 'gyur te/ de bas na byang chub sems dpa' ni shes par bya ba'i sgyu rtsal dang bzo'i bar du yang dumathar phyin par brtson 'grus su slob bo/ /'di lta ste/ shes par bya ba rig pa'i gnas dang / bzo'i gnas dang / rol mo dang / rtsed mo dang /grangs dang / rtsis dang / mig 'phrul gyi ⑦sngags dang / sman dang / ban rjoglang dang / rta dang / bzhon pa dang / dgra chos dang / dmag drang ba dang ske/ dpyad la sogs pa la ⑨mkhas par slob ste/ de ltar sgyu rtsal ci la yang ⑩mkhas par bslabs nas 'gro ba mang po dang / rgyal po dang / blon po chen po la sogs pa yang bsams pa'i yid dang 'gal bar mi byed/ de ma yin pa gzhan yang longs spyod kyi rkyen gos sam/ nor ram/ zas sam/ bza' ba'am / btung ba'am/ nor bu'am/ gdu bu'am/ lus kyi rgyan nam/gser ram/ dngul tsolam/ bai drurya'am8/ byi ru'am/8 man shel lam8/spug gam/ mu tig gam/ a mra gar bha'ams/ nor bu rin po che'am/ ban ⑩glang ngam/ rta'am/ theg pa'am/ bran po'am/ las byed pa'i mi'am/chung ma'am/ slas kyang yod/ chu mig gam/ khrus kyi rdzing bu'am/ rin po che'i yang tog bzang po'am/ longs spyod kyi yo byad rnam pa sna tshogs yod kyang 76—298

byang chub sems dpa' de la rlom pa'am rgyags pa'i sems med do/ /de ltar sgyu ༅rtsal kun la yang mkhas/ rin po che'i bang mdzod brgya stong dang yang ldan/ban glang dang / rta dang / theg pa yang yod/ na chung ②bzang ①mo yang grangs med par yod/ yang tog bzang po yang yod/ chu mig dang khrus kyi rdzing bu la sogs pa 'dod pa'i longs spyod gang yang yod mod kyi/ de la ma ⑤chags te rtag tu 'dod pa nyung ba dang / chog ⑤shes pa la dga' zhing / bas mtha' dgon pa dang / ri dang / tshal dang / shing drung du bsam gtan la zhi bar gnas pa la mos so/ /skye bo mang po dang / smra zhing gtam zer yang sems ni rtag tu gnyen po'i sgor 'jug par byed do/ /so so'i duskye bo dang spyod tshul 'thun pa ltar byed kyang sems can la phan pa'i don du nor bu rin po che gtong bar byed kyis ⑦sems can la gnod pa mi phan pa'i don mi byed do/ /gang dbul ba/ phongs pa nyam ⑤thag par gyur pa dag byang chub sems dpa' la slong du 'ongs na de la ci 'dod pa bzhin byang chub sems dpa' sbyin par byed do/ /sems can gang zhig sangs rgyas kyi chos la mos shing dad de byang chub sems dpa' la bsnyen bkur dang / mchod pa bya ba'i phyir rim gro dang g.yog byed cing rkang pa 'khru ba'i las byed dam/ lus ⑨bkru ba dang mnye ba'i las byed dam/ chag chag dang phyag dar byed dam/ so shing dang khrus chur sbyor ram/mal stan 'dings shing mal gos sprug spre )pa'i las byed dam/ srod dang tho ⑫rangs la mar me 'bud dam/ khye'u 7sus dang / dro la kha zas 8tha na pa na dang / pu she na tsodang / kha da ne 'bul lams/ 'thung ba'i skom yu li shi dang ske/ bu la ⑩sha ku'i 'bras bu'i skom dang / rgyan chu dang / kha ra nag po'i 76—299

chu la sogs pa sbyar sbyar nas yo byad de lta bus zhag bdun nas ①zhag dgu bcu'i bar du byang chub sems dpa' la chos 'dod pa'i phyir 'bul bar byed na byang chub sems dpa' de'i tshe mchod pa'i yo byad 'bul ba de la dga' ba'i sems med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' ni bskal pa ⑤grangs med pa ①yun ring po nas sangs rgyas kyi chos tshol ba'i phyir/ sems can thams cad la skyed 'bri'i ④sems med pa'i phyir/ byams pa dang snying rje'i sems dang ldan pa'i phyir/ mnyam snyoms pa'i sems la gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /de bas na dus kha cig tu 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po byed de/ rtag tu dge ba bcu'i chos kyis ④sems can gyi don byed do/ /sems can de dag kyang rgyal po'i yid bzhin du dga' zhing spyod pas yitshe'i dus byas na yang lha dang mi'i 'jig rten du 'dod pa lnga'i longs spyod mchog dam pa dang ldan te/ rigs che zhing mtho bar skye bar 'gyur/ bsams ⑦pa'i yid bzhin du nyal ba dang / ldang ba dang /'gro ba la gnod pa med par 'gyur/ gnas gang du 'gro yang bzhon pa'i rta dang theg par ldan te skyed (0mos tshal du rtsed mo dang rol mo la rtse zhing longs spyod par 'gyur/ bza' ba dang btung ba tho)dam pa dang dga' dgur 7spyod par 'gyur yang tha ma mi rtag pa bsten 7te/ rga ba dang na bas gzir te shi bar gyur na khyim gyi bu smad mya ngan gyis gdungs te skad phyung nas ngu zhing la la ni mgo la thal mo debasahunye/ la la ni rang rang gi spa 8'bal te mchi ma 'dzag cing sa la 'gre'o④ / /de nas khyogs mesam shing rta'i steng du bzhag nas dur khrod du bskyel tsote / de ltar bskyal nas kyang bu smad dag 0phyir khyim du 'ongs nas mya ngan gyis gdungs te la la ni brgyal (snyenas sa la 'gre/ la la ni de'i rkyen gyis nad du 76—300

'gyur① / la la ni mi dran nas 〈myos/ la la ni ②che'i bar chad du shi bar byas te / de ltar byas kyang gson pa rnams la ni phan pa med/ shi ba la ni rab tu gnod do/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas te yul rgyu zhing song ba las sems can mya ngan gyis gzir ba mthong nas snying brtse ④ba'i sems skyes te 'di skad zer ro/ /rgyal po zhes bya ba ni yul sa dbang gis ⑤'gro ba mang po'i dbang sgyur te/ de ltar dge ba bcu'i lam gyis 'gro ba rnams btul yite/ 'bras bu 'dod pa lnga mchog dam pa thob tu zin kyang skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba dang / mi rtag pas ⑦'jigs pa las duthar bar ma gyur na/ bdag gis drang po'i chos kyis yul gyi srid btsas kyang phan pa'i don med do/ /de ltar 'gro ba rnams la phan pa'i don med na 'khor los sgyur ba'i 0rgyal po chen po 0zhes kyang ji skad 0bya/ byams pa chen po'i 8pha zhe'am/ sman pa'i 8rgyal po chen po zhe'am/ 'dren pa'i ston pa chen po zhes ji skad du gdags8/ 'dren pa'i ston pa chen po zhes bya ba ni yang dag pa'i 8lam du 'dren cing mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam ston te/ 'dus ma byas pa'i rab tu bde ba thob par byed do/ /bdag cag ni ming dang spyod par mi 'thun te⑩/ dper na mi zhig skom pas gdungs tsonas srog la bab pa las chu 'dod pa'i phyir phan tshun brgyugs bla te/ khron pa skam 7po zhig dang phrad nas rab tu dga' ba'i sems skyes te 'di snyam du sems so/ /da ni bdag gi lus 'di 'chi ba las phyir sos so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gal te chu dang ma phrad na srog 'di 'chi ba las yun bu mi ring ba las da khron pa bzang po dang phrad nas gdon mi za bar chu dong grang mo gtsang ma dang phrad de ngoms shing tshim par 'gyur 76—301

bas srog 'tsho bar 'gyur ro snyam bsams ①nas myur ba myur bar khron pa'i drung du bsnyen to/ /khron pa'i drung du phyin nas lus la gyon pa'i gos phud de/phyogs gcig tu sbas nas chu 'dod pa'i phyir khron pa'i nang du zhugs so/ /khron pa'i gting du phyin nas ②chu ni med kyi sbrul gdug pa dang / smigs ③pa dang /sdig pa dang / tsangs pa ④dang / sbal pa dang / gyo mo dang / de la sogs pa gseg ma dang / shing dang / rtswa ⑤nyal nyil 'ba' zhig mthong bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe skom pas nyam thag par gyur pa ༷de thog ma re ⑦ba bzhin du chu yang ma rnyed la gdug pa mang pos gzas dunas khron pa de las phyir byung bar gzas kyang khron pa rnyings 0shing zhig la zabs 0kyang mda' rgyang gang tsam yod de/ de'i nang na 7skas sam/ thag srad dam/ 'bru ba'i shing tsam yang med de/ mas mchong du stsal 8yang nyam thag la stobs zhan pas 'phar mi nus te/ phyir yang zhabs su lhung nas sbrul gdug pa la sogs pas za zhing 'jib bo/ /de cung ⑫zad cig srog ma chad kyi bar du 'di skad ces zer ro/ /bdag khron pa 'di'i nang na chu med par sngar shes na lta khron pa 'di ④la mig gis blta 0yang mi 0phod na 'di'i nang du zhugs pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ da ⑩ni khron pa 'di'i rkyen gyis 8sdug bsngal ba'i sdug bsngal myong bar gyur to 'o)zhes smre sngags 'don totshu/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po yang de ltar so so'i 0skye bo dag gcig shi ba'i 'og tu khyim gang gi bu rngo nyesmad dang / gnyen rnams kyis 0sdug pa dang bye bral ba'i sdug bsngal gyis gdungs pa mthong nas 'di skad zer ro/ /bdag gi lus 'di ni khron pa skam po de dang 'dra ste/ khron pa ④ming tsam yod kyi chu ni med pas na 'jug pa yod kyang thob pa med pas de lta bu'i lus dang srog stor ba'i 76—302

sdug bsngal myong bar gyur to①/ /da ltar bdag 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i dbang sgyur zhing rin po che sna bdun dang ldan te/ dge ba bcu'i las kyis ②'gro ba 'dul zhing drang po'i chos kyis ③yul gyi srid btsas nas skye bo mang po dag lha dang mi'i mtho ris kyi gnas su bkod de 'dod pa lnga'i yon tan mchog dam pa la longs spyod du bcug kyang de dag skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang /'chi ba dang / sdug pa dang rjo/ bye bral ba ⑤dang / dgra sdang ba dang phrad pa'i sdug bsngal las thar bar ma ⑥nus te/ gcig la gcig ngu zhing cho nge byed pa 'di ni bdag gis ②nyes kyi sems can rnams kyis ⑧ma nyes so/ /de ji lta zhe na / bdag la 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos 'gro ba mang po la phan pa'i don du 'gyur ba med de/ bdag las dge ba'i chos 'dod cing rab tu bde ba 'dod kyang sdug bsngal gyi mtsho las rgal ①mi nus so/ /de'i tshe 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po yang 'di snyam du sems so/ /da ltar bdag gi 7lus 'di ni dper na shes pa med pa gti mug can gyi sbyin bdag dang 'dra'o/ /de'i tshe dus gzhan zhig na lo bdun gyi bar du char ⑩ma bab pas than pa chen po byung ste/ rtsi shing yang skams8/ 'bru yang rab tu dkon par gyur nas 0mu ge chen po byung ste/gcig la gcig 'cha' zhing za bar gyur④/ gcig 8gi sha khrag la gcig za ste/la la ni bu'i sha khrag la pha ma za/ la la ni pha ma'i sha la bu za zhing / pha ma dang /phu nu dang / khyo shug dang / bu pho dang / bu mo yang gcig gi sha la gcig za bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe na sbyin bdag chen po de 'chag cing 'phyan ⑩du song song ba las sems can mang po dag ltogs ⑩nas da rod nyams de tsorid cing skams tsol nyam du chung la mdog ngan pa dang / spa yang 'dzings nas lus gnag 076—303

la rke ba chadag phrag zhu pa la mi ro khur du khyer te/ kha cig ni mi'i mgo dang /lag pa dang / rkang pa dang / lhu tshigs dang / lag ngar dang / phrag pa dang ske/ tshigs pa dang / rgal ③pa dang / brla dang / rje ngar dang / yan lag dang / nying lag gi bar du khyer/ kha cig ni nang khrol mchin pa dang /mtsher pa dang / glo ba dang / rgyu ④ma dang / gzhang durnams khyer ba mthong ngo ske/ /de lta bu dag mthong nas sbyin bdag des de dag mthong nas khyed khur du khyer ba 'di dag ci yin zhes dris so/ /de dag gis smras ⑥pa/ bdag cag gi khur du khyer ba 'di ⑦dag ni mi ro steni/ mi'i mgo dang / rkang lag dang /brla dang / rje ngar dang / yan lag dang / nying lag gi bar du'o/ /khyed mi'i mgo dang / yan lag dang / nying lag gi bar du khyer ba 'di ci dgos ⑨ci zhig bya zhes dris pa dang / de dag gis smras pa/ khyod mi shes sam/ mu ge chen po byung nas 'bru rab tu dkon par gyur te/ mi kun ltogs nas da ⑩ltar gcig la gcig za bas/ bdag cag gi khur bu mkhyer ba 'di ni bdag cag gi zas yin no/ /de'i tshe sbyin bdag chen po des de skad ces smras pa de 8thos nas dngangs 8te/ spu zing zhes byed nas 'khams ④te sa la 'gyel ba las chu grang mos 8gdong du gtor nas ring zhig lon pa dang / sems sor chud yinas 'o na khyod ⑩kyi zas yin na 'di dag su'i sha yin zhes 8dris pa dang ⑪/ de dag skad chen po phyung nas rsha )ngus te sto/ sbyin bdag la brjod du mi zhu )rung ngo zhes smras so ste//kye buma'o bdag cag ni sdug go/ /kye 3mtho bdag cag ni sdug go/ /kyi hud kyi hud khyod la drang por mi smrar mi rung ste/ bdag cag khur du khyer ba 'di la la ni pha'i sha /la la ni ma'i sha29 /la la ni bu'i sha /la la ni phu nu'i 0sha /76—304

la la ni gnyen bshes 51)kyi sha yin no zhes ltogs pa tsho de dag gis so so nas khyim bdag la drang por sne)gtam byas nas/ bdag cag ni shin tu ltogs (cadapas gcig la gcig nying sha za bar gyur to5/ /de'i tshe sbyin bdag des dbugs kyis brnangs pa tsam du mi ltogs 6)pa rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyed rnams deng phyin chad gcig la gcig nying sha za bar ma byed cig /khyed rnams la dgos (7pa'i yo byad gang yang rung / bgo ba'i gos sam/ bza' ba'am/btung (nyeba'am/ nad kyi rkyen rtsi'am9/ yo byad ci dgos pa thams cad sbyin par bya ste/ zhag bdun na khyed rnams 1 kho bo'i sgor shog shig dang / yid bzhin du gos sam/ kha zas sam/ nad kyi rkyen rtsi'am/ ji 11'dod pa tshim par bya'o zhes bsgo ba dang / de dag rab tu dga' rangs nas shin tu legs so legs so/ /ngo mtshar che'o zhes bstod pa byas so/ /de nas sbyin bdag de phyir khyim du 'ongs nas chung ma dang / bu rnams dang / bran khol dang /las byed pa'i mi rnams kyang bsdus te/ dga' ba'i mdangs phyung nas lha/'jam zhing yid du 'ong ba'i tshig snyan pas bu smad dang / bran khol dang /las byed pa'i mi rnams la 'di skad ces bsgo'o1lha/ /khyed rnams shes par gyis shig /kho bos smras pa'i tshig legs par nyon cig /khyed shes sam than pa chen pos mu ge byung nas/ mi thams cad ltogs te grangs med pa zhig shi bar gyur to / /bdag gi khyim na bang mdzod kun gang zhing lud de 'bru yang grangs med pa zhig yod pas dus las chom yol bar bdag cag bsod nams bya'o zhes bu smad kun gyis de skad ces bsgo 15ba thos nas legs so legs so/ /bdag cag gi srog lus sbyin pa byas kyang mi phangs na sabang mdzod dang / nor rdzas dang /76—305

kha zas lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de nas sbyin bdag kyang rab tu dga' rangs nas khyed rnams ni yang dag par kho bo'i bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i lagrogs yin pa lta dge'o legs so/ /khyed rnams kyang so so nas ci dang ci bya ba rnams ci dang ci bsgrub ②pa skol bya ba'i rigs pa yang med la bya/ bsgrub ①pa'i rigs ④pa yang myur du bsgrub ste/ da ste zhag bdun na nges par 'byor bar bya'o/ /de'i tshe sbyin bdag des so sor bsgo nas khyim gyi phyi rol du byung ste/gang nas mnyam zhing yangs dul bde ba'i gnas zhig bltas nas 0mod la sa gzhi medag par nyal nyil dang dus rdo med par byas phyags 0te khri stan 0bshams sol/ /de ltar mang po ⑩'du ba'i gnas sbyin pa sbyin pa'i sa gzhi 8bshams nas ban glang lnga brgya la kha zas bkal te sbyin pa'i sar bskyal nas/ kha zas ni 0ri bzhin du spungs/ zho chu ni mtsho bzhin bskyilas/ mar dang / 'bru mar dang /khur 8ba la sogs pa kha zas ro brgya dang ldan pa cho ma cho dgu sbyar te⑩/ de ma yin ⑩pa gzhan yang 8gos dang / gdu bu dang / phreng ba dang / lus kyi rgyan 0sna tshogs du byedang / ban glang dang / rta dang / rin po che sna bdun la sogs te/ thams cad phun sum tshogs par sbyar nas zhag bdun lon pa'i skya rengs 0shar nas zhag bdun gyi nyi ma la 'dril rnga brdungasadu/ dung bus te/skad chen pos thams cad sbyin pa'i gnas 'dir 'dus shing shog bushig ces bos so / /de'i tshe na thams cad kyis bos pa'i skad thos nas 'phags pas byin gyis brlabs pa tsam du rab tu phyedaga' ba'i sems skyes te/ thams cad sbyin pa gtong ba'i gnas su lhags te/ yid bzhin du gos dang / mal cha dang /zas 0skom dang / lus kyi rgyan tsosna tshogs pa dang / nad kyi rtsi 3sman mang po 76—306

dang ske/ ban glang dang / rta dang / rin po che sna bdun la sogs pa ci dang ci 'dod pa yid bzhin du drangs nas sbyin pa'i rdzas ci yod pa thams cad kyis ma lus par khyer ro/ /de nas sbyin bdag de dga' nas phyir khyim du 'ongs nas chung ma dang bu rnams dga' ba bzhin du 'dod pa lnga la longs spyod do/ /de nas ①zhag bdun tsam lon pa dang mi dag na re sbyin bdag des sngar gos dang / zas dang ske/ skom la sogs pa (misbyin pa ①byas na kha zas zos ④pa rnams dug langs nas thams cad shi'o zhes zer ro/ /de ltar shi bar gyur pas thams cad 2tshig tu brjod de ngo mtshar che'o ngo mtshar che'o/ /de 6)ltar sbyin bdag chen po des kun la snying brtse ba'i phyir ⑦ci 'dod pa bzhin du kha zas la sogs pas tshim par byas te lus dang srog gson par byas par (8)gyur na phyis zhag mang po ma lon par 6)dug langs nas thams cad shi'o bar sgra masgrogs par gyur to/ /de'i tshe sbyin bdag chen po 7des de ltar gyur pa de 8thos nas yi mug cing mi dga' bar gyur te / chung ma dang / bu la sogs pa la khyed kyi tu kha zas ji ltar sbyar na cikha zas kyi nang du dug ma rungs pa ji ltar 'ongs zhes dris pa dang / chung ma dang /bu dang / bran khol dang / las byed pa'i mi rnams kyi mchid nas dug mi srid do8rka/ /dug 'di ga las 'ongs zhib tu rtogs shig ces smras so/ /de nas sbyin bdag de khyim gyi zhal ta tshebyed cing mthar gyis song song ba las khron pa zhig steng bkab cing g.yogs pa mthong ngo / /khron pa 'di ci'i phyir g.yogs zhes dris pa dang ske/ khron pa 'di ni khyim bdag 7khyod bus pa chung ngu'i tshe na sprul gdug pa gsum zhig gso gso ba las khron pa 'di brkos nas sbrul gdug pa gsum bcug go / /khron pa 'di ni sbrul gdug pa 'dug hu3pa'i khron pa yin no/ /chu yang 76—307

gdug pas chu 'di yang 'thungs pas na ste 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /sbyin bdag des tshig de dag thos nas las byed pa dag la khyed de ①bar kha zas g.yo ba'i tshe khron chu 'di las bcus te kha zas ma g.yos sam/ las byed pas smras pa/ kha zas mang du g.yos pas ②rings nas chu 'di yang ①bcus nas kha zas kyi ④g.yos byas so zhes bsgo'o/ /khyim bdag mi dga' ste/ ngo mtshar che'o/ /bdag ni gti mug can shes pa'i blo med pa yin pa 'dra ste/ ci'i phyir sbrul gdug pa gso zhing khron pa gdug pa rko zhes 'gyod phyinas chung ma dang / bu la bsgo ba/ sbrul gdug pa gsum gyi khron ⑥pa myur du tshongs ༅shig /sbrul gdug pa gsum yang ⑦kho bo bdag gis (pebasreg go zhes bsgo ba dang / las byed pa'i mi rnams kyis de ma thag tu khron pa de yang bsubs tsonas med par byas so/ /de nas sbyin bdag des sbrul gdug pa'i khron pa de med par byas nas phyi rol du 'chag tu song song ⑫ba las sbyin bdag gi kha zas dug can gyi 8shi bar gyur pa las 8thams cad tshig 'thun par sbyin bdag 'dis bdag cag la kha zas dug can byin nas bdag cag sngar shi bar gyur pa yin no/ /bdag cag gis de ltar shes na der ma song yang rung zhes 'gyod pa skyes so/ /de bzhin du 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po de yang dge ba bcus sems can btul te/ sems can dag lha dang mi'i mtho ris su 0skye zhing 'dod pa lnga la 'dod dgur 8longs spyod mod kyi skye ba dang ⑩/ rga ba dang / na ba dang 'o tsho/ 'chi ba las mi thar ba yang de dang 'dra'o/ /de nas 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po de rtso)de'i mod la bdag bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos bsgrubs te/ sems can rnams kyang de la /7klog pa dang / 'don pa dang / 'dri ba dang / goms par 76—308

bya ste/ skye shi'i 'khor ba yongs su spang zhing 0)mya ngan las 'das pa 'thob ②par bya'o zhes dam bcas so/ /de'i tshe na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po sangs rgyas kyi chos tshol ba'i phyir/ 'dzam bu'i gling na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos sus shes zhes gnas kun tu bkar ⑧btags so/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po chos 'dod pa'i phyir gnas (9kun tu bkar btags kyang shes pa ma byung ngo / /mtha' 'khob kyi yul chung ngu cig tu phyin pa dang / de na bram ze gcig cig sangs rgyas kyi chos shes so ⑤zhes zer ro/ /de nas bram ze de'i steng du pho nya btang dunas pho nya des ༅bram ze ga la ba der phyin (kyenas btsun pa sangs rgyas kyi chos shes sam zhes dris na shes so zhes zer ro/ /de nas pho nyas bram ze'i rkang pa la mgo bos phyag byas nas btsun pa 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal pos spyan 'dren du btang gis 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po de ga la ba der gshegs su gsol/ /de nas bram ze yang der 'ongs nas 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal pos rgyang ma nas bsu ste rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas bde bar byon tam/ lam du nyon mongs par ma gyur tam/ ngal bar ma gyur tam/ zhes gtam dris te pho brang gi nang du khrid nas pho brang gi dbus su rgyal po'i gdan la bzhag go/ /bram zes kyang gdan la skyil mo krung (1)bcas te 'dug nas 3 )de'i tshe rgyal pos bram ze de bde bar 'dug nas dgos pa'i yo byad rnams kun phul te sbyin pa byas nas thal mo sbyar te bram ze de la ston pa chen po sangs rgyas kyi chos shes sam zhes dris pa dang ske/ bram ze na re bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi chos 'o/shes so zhes /la)zer ro/ /de nas rgyal pos bram ze la ston pa chen po bdag la bstan cing bshad du gsol zhes byas nas8/ bram ze na re rgyal po khyod ni shin tu glen no/ /kho bos sangs 76—309

rgyas kyi chos bslabs pa na/ yun ring du na ①dka' ba'i sdug bsngal myong nas gdod lobs pa yin na/ da rgyal pos thal byung ②du thos par 'dod dam/rgyal pos smras pa/ ston pa chen po 'o na ci zhig 'dod/ bram zes smras pa/②bdag la mchod pa phul cig /rgyal pos smras pa/ ston pa chen po mchod pa ci zhig 'dod/ gos byasam/ mal cha'am/ bza' ba'am/ btung ba 'dod dmal/ 'on te gser ram/ dngul lam/ rin po che 'dod dam/ bram zes smras pa/ bdag de 'dra ba'i mchod pa mi 'dod do/ /rgyal pos smras pa/mchod pa de dag mi 'dod na 'o na ban glang ngam/ rta'am/ theg pa 'dod dam / 'on te yul lam/ grong khyer ram/ chung ma'am/ bu 'dod dam/rol mo'am/ glu'am/ gar byed pa 'dod dam/ bram zes smras pa/ bdag ni de dag gang yang mi 'dod do/ /gal te lus la rma stong phyung ste rma'i nang du ⑤mar blugs la me mar snying po btsugs te mar me stong 'bar bas bumachod na sangs rgyas kyi chos bstan cing bshad par bya'o/ /gal te de ltar mi nus na bdag langs te 'gro zhes smras nas rgyal pos skad cig tsam lan ma smras kyi bar du khri las babs so/ /de nas rgyal pos pang du blangs nas ston pa chen po cung zad nyag bsring ⑦du gsol/ bdag shes pa zhan zhing bsod nams chung bas ducung zad bsams te mchod par ⑨bgyid do zhes smras so/ /de'i tshe 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po de 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ bdag gi tsolus 'di thog ma med pa'i dus nas shi ba grangs med par myong na yang chos kyi phyir ma shi'i0// da yang bdag gi lus 'di yang mthar 'jig cing rul bar 'gyur bas 'phan pa med de/ da ni dus las 0bab bo snyam bsams nas ston pa bram ze la 'di skad 76—310

ces smras so/ /ston ①pa chen po/ bdag mchod pa 'dod pa bzhin bgyid do/ /de nas rgyal po pho brang du song nas btsun mo rnams la da ni bdag cag bye 'bral lo zhes smras so/ /btsun mo rnams de skad ces smras pa thos nas dngangs shing 'khams ②te ci nyes gtol med de ②rgyal po da ④ltar ci zhig mdzad (7snyam dgongs zhes gsol lo/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ bdag gi lus 'di la mar me stong zhig btsugs te ston pa bram ze la mchod pa bya snyam mo/ /btsun mo rnams kyis de skad ces smras pa thos nas sa la 'gre zhing cho nges btab ste brgyal 9lo/ /ring zhig lon pa dang / phyir dran pa rnyed dog/ /rgyal po chen po 'jig rten na bdag gi lus las phangs pa med del/ nyes te dogs ⑨nas gso ba'i rim gro cher byed na ci'i phyir bdag gi lus la tho ma'atsham zhing gnod pa 7bgyid/ rgyal po ni mkhas pa'i blo dang ldan pa lags na da ltar myos sam/ 'on te yi dgas kyis brlams 8sam/ ci nongs/ rgyal pos smras pa/ de lta bu gang yang ma yin no/ /'o na ci'i phyir de lta bu'i gnod pa mdzad cing bram ze la mchod par dgongs / rgyal pos smras pa/ bdag ni sangs rgyas kyi chos 'dod de/ sems can thams cad kyi don byed par sems so/ /de ltar sems can thams cad la dgongs na da 8ci'i phyir bdag cag rnams bkol bar gyur/ rgyal pos smras pa/ 'jig rten na ④mdza' sdug thams cad mthar bye bral du 8'gyur te de bas na bdag gis lus kyi tsomachod pa ⑩byas te/ khyed dang sems can thams cad kyi mun gnag 8gi khang par ye shes chen po'i snyon ma gzugs shing skye shir ⑪'khor ba'i ma rig pa'i mun pa snang bar byas la/ kun nas dkris 0pa'i nyon mongs pa'i mdud pa bcad de/ 'khor ba'i skyon las bsgral nas mya ngan las 76—311

'das pa'i gnas su dgod pa'i ched du bsams kyis 0khyed rnams bar chad dang bgegs ma byed cig /de'i tshe btsun mo rnams de skad ces bsgo ba thos nas brnangs pa ltar cang mi smra zhing skad chen po phyung ②ste ngu zhing rang rang gi spa 'bal lo / /bdag cag la bsod nams med de bkra mi shis pas gson por bdag cag la lha med par gyur ces smra'o/ /rgyal po de la rgyal bu lnga brgya yod de thams cad kyang mnga' byad bzang zhing sdug pa/ yid gzhungs shing mkhas pa'i blo dang ldan pa/ mi'i mtshan dang rdzogs par ldan pa/ rgyal po yang mig bzhin du phangs shing byams so/ /de'i tshe rgyal pos rgyal bu rnams la smras pa/ kho bo da mchod pa'i las shig byed snyam na lus dang srog nyam ②chung ngu dogs te byakhyed dang bral ba snyam/ yul gyi srid dang 'bangs rnams kyi phyitshis ni che rims kyis byos shig ces bsgo'o/ /rgyal bu rnams de skad bsgo ba de ༅thos nas lus kyi yan lag dang rtsa rnams bcad pa tsam du sdug bsngal gyis gdungs te/ dper na mi brnangs ⑦pa la skyug tu yang (8༄med/ mid du yang med pa bzhin du rgyal po la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /ci'i slad du bdag cag rnams spangs te skyabs su ⑨ma mchis par spumadzad/ la la ni rgyal po'i gnya' ba nas 'khyud/ la la ni lag pa dang / rkang pa la bzung yinas skad phyung zhing ngu / kyi hud kyi hud ci'i phyir mgon dang skyabs med par 'gyur zhes smras so/ /de nas rgyal pos rgyal bu rnams la spro 51)ba bskyed 3nyepa'i phyir 'jig rten na tsomadza' zhing sdug pa thams cad mthar 8bye bral tshibar 'gyur ro zhes bsgo'o/ /de skad ces bsgo ba thos kyang yid la gcags 1nyete 'bral mi phod na bdag gi 8gsol ba gcig gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ /bdag cag gi 7lus dang srog rgyal po la 'bul na ston 76—312

pa bram ze la mchod pa mdzad du gsol/ rgyal pos smras pa/ bu khyed rnams 6)ni da dung shed ma bye la ②chung bas de 'dra ba'i mchod pa byed mi bzod kyisal/ kho bo ni ston pa lam ring po nas gnyer te mchod pa ④bya bar khas blangs pa'i (nyeyid dang 'gal bar byar mi rung bas bu sri (7zhu can ni pha'i yid dang 'gal bar mi byed na khyed rnams kho bo'i yid dang 'gal bar byed dam/ rgyal bu rnams de skad smra ba thos nas skad phyung ste cho nges btab pas yul gyi lha rnams kyang dngangs (3)te ri 'gyel ba bzhin du thams cad lus sa la (nyebardabs so/ /de'i tshe rgyal po la yul mtha'i rgyal phran thams cad kyis kyang mchi phyag byas nas pho brang gi nang ston pa chen po ga la ba der song ste/ de'i drung du phyin nas lus kyi rgyan thams cad kyang bgrol ⑨nas gos kyang phud nas rsha )phyogs gcig tu bzhag nas lus drang por bsrang ste 'dug go/ /'dug ma thag tu rgyal phran rnams dang / blon po dang /rgyal bu lnga brgya dang / btsun mo nyi khri la bsgo'o/ /khyed rnams las gang gis 7kho bo'i lus la rma stong zhig gcod sus nus zhes smras na/ btsun mo dang /rgyal bu dang / blon po dang / rgyal phran gyi mi (7rnams 3)tshig 'thun par bdag cag gis rka/sterang gi lus la gri thogs te mig phyung yang bla'i argyal po'i lus la rma 'byin mi phod do/ /de nas rgyal po mi dga' bar gyur nas da ni bdag ye 'ur gyur pa 'onyalta 'khor mang po 'di snyed kyi nang na mi 'ga' yang kho bo'i grogs su 'gyur ba med dam zhes smra hu snabar gyur to(rte/ /de'i tshe na 37rgyal po de la rigs ngan shen (3 pa rang bzhin gyis khro la kun kyang 'jigs su rung ba zhig yod pa zhig bos so/ /shen 0pa de der 'ongs so/ /shen pa de 'ongs ( —snyenas rgyal bu rnams la khyed ( nyemya ngan ma byed cig /rgyal po chen po zhustedon mi 'grub pa'i thabs bdag 76—313

la mchis kyis①/ don ma grub na snga mkho bzhin du rgyal po'i srid gzung ②du zad do zhes smras so/ /rgyal bu rnams kyis tshig de skad ces smras pa thos nas rab tu dga' ba'i sems skyes par gyur to②/ /de nas shen 0pa de rgyal po'i drung du 'ongs nas rgyal po chen po da ⑤ltar ci zhig mdzad par dgongs zhes gsol pa dang ske/ rgyal pos smras pa/ kho bo'i lus la mar me stong btsugs ⑥la ston pa chen po bram ze la mchod par sems so/ /shen ⑦pas smras pa/ de lta dun sku la gcod nus so/ /rgyal pos de skad smras pa 8thos nas rab tu dga' ba'i sems su gyur nas shan ⑩pa la khyod ni yang dag par kho bo'i bla na med pa'i byang chub sgrub ⑩pa'i grogs yin no zhes smras so/ /de nas shan 8pas rgyal po'i drung du 'greng bzhin ngu ngam ngur yiba'i skad chen pos rgyal po la 'di skad ces gsol to//rgyal po mkhyen tam/ mi gsad ④pa'i chos kyis ni sngar mgo bcad par tsodagos te / gnya' ba gtubs yil rkang lag kyang tunyephral te/ chu ba dang / rgyus pa yang dbyung dgos na rgyal po chen po de 'dra ba'i na tsha'i 8sdug bsngal bzod dam/rgyal pos de skad smras pa thos nas rab tu dga' ba'i sems su gyur nas/ de nas shen ⑩pas gnag lce lta bu'i gri thogs te ring po ma thogs par rgyal po'i lus la rma stong tshang bar bcad do/ /shan ⑥ pa rgyal po'i sems phyir nur ba tsam du sems pa las/ sems ma nur bas de 0gri yang sa la bor nas bros so/ /de nas rgyal po chen po'i lus la rma stong bcad ④pa'i nang 'du mar khu blugs nas ④ras bzang po'i snying po btsugs te mar me stong btsugs so/ /de'i tshe bram ze ston pa chen pos de ltar byas pa mthong nas 'di snyam du da duni myur du chos ma bshad na lus srog 'tsho'am mi 'tsho gtol med pas/ gal te srog ma sos na 76—314

sus chos mnyan par 'gyur snyam ①bsams nas/ rgyal po la 'di skad ces smras sol/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos thos par ②'dod pas shin tu dpa' ba'i brtson 'grus kyis bya dka' ba'i spyod pa spyad pas legs par nyon la shin tu yid la zung ②shig dang / da rgyal po la sangs rgyas kyi chos bstan par bya'o/ /de skad ces smras dupa thos nas rgyal po rab tu dga' ba'i sems su gyur te/ dper na bu sri zhu can zhig pha ma shi na rab tu mi dga' ste/ sdug bsngal gyis gdungs pa las pha ma phyir sos pa na bu de ji ltar rab tu dga' ba ltar rgyal po de yang rab tu dga' bar gyur to/ /de nas bram ze des rgyal po la smras pa/ skye ba yod na 'chi bar 'gyur / /'gog pa 'di (snyeni bde ba yin/ /zhes tshigs su bcad pa phyed pa dhi'adi bstan to/ /rgyal pos dam pa'i chos bstan pa thos nas rab tu dga' ba'i sems su gyur te/ rgyal bu dang blon po rnams la 'di skad ces bsgo'o(me/ /khyed rnams nikho bo la sdug cing brtse ba'i sems yod na chos 'di ma brjed par yid la zung khyal yul phyogs su gang na mang po 'du ba'i lkuganas dang / grong dang /grong khyer dang / tshong 'dus su 'gro ba mang po la 'di skad ces bkar thogs shig /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po chen pos sems can mang po sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor bying ba dag 'don pa dang / sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po'i sems bskyed nas lus la mar me stong btsugs te/ tshigs su bcad pa'i tshigs bcad byed ⑩thos pa 'di rgyal po chen po 'di'i byams pa dang snying rje'i sems grub par bya ba'i phyir thams cad kyis yi lho ger bris te gdon hu)pa dang /kha ton ④du bya ba dang / 'dri ba dang / goms par byed pa dang / don yang yid la bya zhing ji ltar gtams 8pa bzhin du nan tan du spyad ⑩par bya'o/ /76—315

de'i tshe na (1)mi mang pos de skad ces bsgo ba thos nas rab tu dga' zhing mgu bar gyur te(ge/ thams cad kyis tshig 'thun par rgyal po la bstod rdzu stenas shin tu dga'o/ /rgyal po chen po bdag cag gi snying rje chen po'i pha yang dag pa yin rnam/ /sems can thams cad kyi phyir shin tu spyad dka' ba spyad do rigazhes kun gyis bsngags (5)te/ kun gyis 0shog shog dang / dar dang / shun pa dang / shing dang 3)/ rdo la yi ger bris te kha ton du slob bo/ /gang na mi mang po 'du ba'i gnas su yang yi ger bris te/ thams cad kyis mthong bar (85byas nas/bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed du bcug go/ /de'i tshe rgyal po chen pos lus la mar me stong btsugs te ston pa chen po bram ze la mchod pa byas pa'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i zhing 'jig rten gyi (9nakhams snang bar gyur te/ mar me de'i 'od de las tshigs su bcad pa'i tshigs bcad 1 )phyed nyu1kyi chos kyi sgra yang grags par gyur nyurtenas thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /mar me de'i 'od des sum cu 1)rtsa gsum gnam gyi lha'i khang pa yang snang bar byas nas mar me'i 'od des lha'i 'od kun zil gyis mnan pas sum cu sna rtsa gsum gnam gyi lha rnams skomar me'i 'od des kun tu snang bar byas pas de dag 'di snyam du gyur to/ /ci'i rgyu ci'i rkyen gyis 'od zer 'di lta bu snang bar gyur /tswasnyam/ lha'i mig gis bltas pas nyi tsho'ajig rten gyi khams na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po chen 8pos snying rje'i sems bskyed de/'gro ba thams cad kyi don du cho16lus la mar me stong btsugs 3 nyenas ston pa chen po bram ze la mchod pa byas par ( lhamathong ngo / /lha de dag rab tu dga' ba'i sems skyes nas 'jig rten gyi khams su babs nas mi tha mal pa'i lus su sprul nas rgyal 76—316

po ga la bar lhags te rgyal po chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rgyal po chen po lus la mar me stong btsugs te/ shin tu yang spyod 1dka' ba spyad cing tshigs su bcad pa phyed cig thos pas ci zhig bya/ rgyal pos smras pa/ rigs kyi bu bdag ni sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed du gzhug pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas sprul pa'i mi de phyir brgya byin gyi lus su bsgyur nas lus kyi 'od kyis kun tu snang bar byas te/ rgyal po chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rgyal po chen po 'di ltar mchod pa byas pa 'dis tshon)lha'i rgyal po 'dod dam/ bdud kyi rgyal po 'dod dam/ tshangs pa'i rgyal po 'dod dmatshul/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i tsho4 rgyal pos brgya byin la smras pa/ lha'i dbang (5)po bdag ni lha dang mi'i longs spyod gang yang mi 'dod kyi bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod de96/ so so'i skye bo 97thams cad mi bde ba rnams bde ba'i gnas su dgod pa dang / ma grol ba rnams grol bar bya ba dang /pha rol tu ma phyin pa rnams phyin par bya ba dang / byang chub ma thob pa rnams (8)thob par bya bar 'dod do 9)/ /brgya byin gyis smras pa/ rgyal po chen po khyod ni rab tu blun pa'o(7/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni yun ring por (nya shen tu spyod 512dka' ba spyad pas thob par 'gyur na ci'i phyir bla na med pa'i byang chub 'thob 1stepar 'gyur/ rgyal pos brgya byin la smras pa/ ci ste bdag gi spyi bo'i steng na lcags kyi 'khor los nashin tu 'bar ba rgyun du 'khor yang sdug bsngal de tsam gyis bla na med pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog go/ /brgya byin gyis smras pa/ tshig de skad ces smras pa la su zhig yid ches par 'gyur/de nas 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal pos brgya byin la smras pa/ gal te bdag 8bla 76—317
