bcu tsam dang / zhag lnga lnga tsam du char 'bebs shing / nam gyi gung la sa thams cad dri bzang po dang ro zhim zhing bcud chen por 'gyur te/ de nas sa thams cad rab tu mnyam zhing rdo dang tsher ma med par 'gyur ba yin no/ /grong khyer gyi sgo bzhi dang / zur bzhi dang / grong khyer gyi dbus su dpag bsam gyi shing 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ gzhan yang de yi grong khyer du/ /sna tshogs sna tshogs mang ba'i srang / /mngon par grub pa'i rdzing bu la / /them skas shin tu legs par 'byung / /chu chen shin du dri ma med/ /bsil zhing dri zhim yid 'ong ldan/ /bde mnyam ngang pa du mar bcas/ /bye ma mu tig mdog 'dra ba/ /uta pal pad mo'i me tog 'khrigs/ /dus rnams kun du rnyings 97ma 'khrungs/ /rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi/ /ta la'i ra ba bdun gyis bskor/ /de'i rinogrong khyer thams cad la/ /rin chen lcags ri bdun gyis bskor/ /de tshe rtswa mchog grong khyer 'dir/ /grong khyer rgyal mtshan blo gros 'byung / /grong khyer zur bzhi dang ni sgor/ /dpag bsam ljon shing rab tu skye/ /sngon po ser po dmar po dang / /kha dog sna tshogs 'od zer can/ /lha yi gos ni de las skye/ /lha yi rgyan rnams de las 'byung / /gzhan yang dgos 'dod sna tshogs pa/ /thams cad de las rab tu 'byung / /grong khyer de yi dbus su yang / /sgo bzhi bzhi ldan khang bzangs 5ldebazhi/ /bsod nams las las rab tu 'grub/ /dpag bsam ljon shing mang po 'khrigs/ /ka shi'i gos dang kub pa sa/ /la ma u dum 'ba' ra'i gos/ /bsod nams las las rab grub pa'i/ /dpag bsam shing las rab tu 'byung / /lag rnga dang ni rdza rnga dang ske/ /rnga skum dag ni phrag rnga yang / /bsod nams las las rab grub pa'i/ /76—855

dpag bsam shing las rab tu 'byung / /rin chen phreng ba mgul rgyan dang / /rin chen phreng ba'i do shal yang / /bsod nams las las rab grub pa'i/ /dpag bsam shing las rab tu 'byung / /gtsug rgyan mdzod spu'i rgyan dang ni/ /dpung rgyan nor bu'i sked rgyan dang / /bsod nams las las rab 'grub pa'i/ /dpag bsam shing las rab tu 'byung / /gzhan yang sna tshogs du ma yi/ /rgyan mang legs po thams cad ni/ /bsod nams las las rab grub pa'i/ /dpag bsam shing las rab tu 'byung / /bsod nams las can sems can la/ /ma grubs lkogs med dri med dkar/ /dri zhim 'bras kyi snye ma 'grub/ /ma rmos ma btab rang byung la/ /ma g.yos ma bskol 'bras kyi zas/ /mi rnams thams cad legs par za/ /der ni rtsa ba gcig las kyang / /'bras kyi yal ga 'bum phrag skye/ /sdong bu kun la myug gu rnams/ /thams cad re res kun nas bskor//'bras rnams so ma re re la/ /de tshe bre ni re re 'byung / /dus kun dri zhim ldan pa'i 'bras/ /mi kun la ni 'byung ba yin/ /'khor lo gnyis bī shing rta ni/ /nyis stong dang ni nyis brgya dang / /shing rta bdun bcu rtsa gnyis dang / /khal ni bcu drug de bzhin du/ /ku ba gnyis dang bcas pa'i 'bras/ /sems can bsod nams ldan pas na/ /sa bon gcig las de snyed 'byung / /rgyal po dung gi grong khyer ni/ /rgyal mtshan blo gros der gnas mi/ /thams cad ma lus de kun kyang / /yon tan kun ldan rgyan rnams 'dzin/ /yid la gang bsam bde bar 'byor/ /gzugs bzang me tog rgyan la sogs/ /ha ri tsan dan lus la byugs / /ka shi ka yi gos mchog gyon/ /gnyen gshin nor mang dbang phyug ldan / /pi wang ting ting shags kyis rtse/ /lus dang de bzhin yid rnams kyang //76—856

nyin mtshan med par shin tu skyid/ /'dzam gling 'di yi rgya khyon yang / /dpag tshad stong phrag bcu yin te/ /tsher ma can dang mtha' 'khob med/ /khad mnyam ljang khu'i rtsa gsar ldan/ /'dod dang rgas dang mthar 'chi ste/ /nad gsum tsam ni de tshe yod/ /bu mo lnga brgya'i lo lon tshe/ /khyim thab la ni 'gro bar byed/ /kun du sems 'thun bde dang ldan/ /'thab dang rtsod pa med par gnas/ /me tog 'bras bu mang po dang / /'khri shing shing thog yod pa'i tshal / /sor bzhi'i dpangs tsam rtswa rnams rigs/ /shing bal lta bur reg bya 'jam / /bsil drod shin du snyoms pa ste/ /char dang rlung yang shin du snyoms/ /de tshe dbyar dgun ston yang snyoms/ /mtsho dang 'bab chu rlabs med cing / /sa kun de dang de ru ni/ /gseg ma bye ma dkar po yang / /sran ma dang ni sran dkar tsam/ /mu tig lta bu mang pos mdzes/ /legs par brgyan pa'i tshal bzhin du/ /kun nas bzang po 'byung ba yin/ /grong dang grong rdal 'dab 'brel ba/ /de der nye zhing shin du nye/ /snyug 0)ma'i tshal dang 'od ma'i tshal/ /kun du khyim bya mang po rgyu/ /nor mang phyug cing 'jigs pa med/ /kun du khrims bzang gnod med ldan/ /nyin mtshan 'dod yon lnga yis rtse/ /gcig tu bde bar gnas pa yin/ /skar ma'i 'od kyi mda' ltar 'gro/ /yid rab dang zhing bde dgas gnas/ /bza' dang btung ba bzang zhing mang / /sha dang chang sogs mang por ldan/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan dang ni/ /lha yi grong khyer lcang lo can/ /yangs pa can gyi grong khyer bzhin/ /'dzam gling kun nas bzang por 'gyur/ /de'i dus na byang chub sems dpa' byams pa 'di grangs med pa'i bskal pa 'bum phrag gcig dang bcu drug tu sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs 76—857

pa pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad rdzogs nas thams cad sgrol ba'i tshul gyis tha ma nyid du sbyin pa chen po ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshogs thams cad mthar phyin cing 'di nas dga' ldan du mngon par skyes te/ de'i dus na 'jig rten gyi khams stong phrag bcu'i lha thams cad 'ongs te sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes sgra dbyangs snyan pa chen po 'byin cing mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gsol zhes skul bar byed do/ /de nas gzigs pa rnam pa lnga la mngon par gzigs te/ dga' ldan gyi lha'i 'khor nas 'ongs te rgyal po dung gi grong khyer rgyal mtshan blo gros su bram ze mdun na 'don tshangs rab ces bya ba'i btsun mo tshangs ldan ma zhes bya ba'i lhums su 'jug ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams stong phrag bcu 'dar zhing g.yo bar 'gyur ro/ /der zla ba bcu song nas drang srong lhung ba'i ri dgas (1)rgyu ba'i gnas su yum las 'khrungs te/ rim gyis nar son nas rang gi bsod nams kyi mthu las sa 'og nas nor bu rin po che bdun las grub pa'i khang bzangs bzhi byung ba'i nang du rang nyid lha bzhin du lha mo zla ba'i gdong can dang / gzhan yang lha mo lta bu'i bud med mang po dang lhan cig tu lo sto nga phrag gcig tu lha'i longs spyod lta bu la bde bar spyod do/ /de nas tha ma'i zhag la btsun pa'i gzugs zhig mthong nas gser gyi khang bur seng ge'i rgyal po mi dga' ba bzhin du rin po che'i khang bzangs dpal mang po yod pa la mi dga' zhing nges par 'byung ba chen po'i sems byung ste/ 'jig rten 'khor lo stong phrag bcu thams cad kyi lha rnams lha'i me tog lag tu khyer nas 'jig rten gyi 'khor lo 'dir 'ongs te 'khod par byed do/ /rgyal po dung dang bcas pa'i mi mang po yang me tog dang dri dang spos khyer te khang bzangs la bskor nas 'khod 76—858

par byed do/ /nam mkha'i lha rnams kyang lha'i me tog lag tu khyer nas legs so legs so/ /zhes 'og min gyi bar du sgra cher sgrogs shing 'khod par byed do/ /de nas rin po che'i khang bzangs rdza mkhan gyi 'khor lo bzhin du 'khor zhing nam mkha' la song nas bcwa lnga'i zla ba skar ma'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' ni zla ba'i gdong can ma dang / gzhan btsun mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa nam mkha' la 'gro bar byed do/ /sems dpa' chen po de dang thabs gcig tu 'gro ba'i sems yod pa thams cad kyang nam mkha' la 'gro bar byed do/ /de nas tshangs pa chen pos ni dpag tshad gsum tsam yod pa'i gdugs dkar por 'dzin cing lha'i dbang po'i rgyal pos dung 'bud par byed do / /'di ltar bsod nams kyi dpal chen po'i lha dang mis bskor ba'i khang bzangs dang bcas pas byang chub kyi shing gi drung du nye bar 'ongs te/ de ji ltar zhe na/ shing sdong khru brgya nyi shu ste/ /yal ga'ang khru brgya nyi shu'i srid/ /rlung gis dal bur bskyod pa na/ /rma bya'i gar gyi gdugs ltar snang / /dus kun lha yi me tog ni/ /shin du legs par rgyas pa yang / /'khor lo tsam gyi lte ba la/ /ge sar dri bzang bre gang tsam/ /rlung gis phyogs bcur bskyod pa na/ /dpag tshad bcur ni dri yis khyab/ /me tog sa la bab pa yang / /byang chub shing drung nyid du gnas/ /de'i dus su nam mkha' la 'gro ba'i bya'i rigs mang po skad snyan pos mchod pa byed cing 'gro bar byed do/ /de ltar na byang chub kyi shing klu shing gi nye 'khor du 'ongs te nam mkha' las babs nas khang bzangs sa'i nye 'khor yid du 'thad pa'i steng de nyid du 'khod par byed do/ /der dpal gyi khang bzangs kyi nang du zhag bdun du dka' thub byed do/ /de nas 76—859

tshangs pa chen pos phul pa mkho ba'i yo byad blangs te rab tu byung bar byed do/ /'khor thams cad kyang rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste/ brgyad khri bzhi stong grangs snyed kyi/ /bram ze rig byed la mkhas pa/ /de yi rjes su rab tu 'byung / /'khor rnams kun kyang rab tu 'byung / /de ltar rab tu byung nas lha mo zla ba'i gdong can mas phul ba'i 'o thug ro sna tshogs dang ldan pa gsol bar byed do/ /de'i dgong thun la byang chub kyi shing drung du nye bar 'ongs te rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzangs su khri bshams pa la shar gyi 'jig rten la mngon par gzigs te bzhugs par mdzad do/ /de nas rim gyis nyi ma'i skya rengs shar ba'i dus na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes mngon du mdzad de 'di skad gsung bar 'gyur ro/ /'khor ba'i skye ba mang por ni/ /dug med pa'i don gyi phyir/ /gnas bzang kun du btsal byas kyang / /yang yang skye ba'i sdug bsngal byung / /da ni gnas bzang mchog thob pas/ /da gzod gnas gzhan 41 mi 'gro ste/ /dug khyim sdug bsngal thams cad bcas/ /rab bcom tho bas bshig pa yin/ /nyon mongs dug bcas 'dod pa yi/ /yid ni rnam par dag par byas/ /'di skad ces gsungs nas byang chub kyi shing la nye bar gnas te zhag bdun phrag bdun song ba dang / tshangs pas gsol ba 'debs pa gsan nas drang srong lhung ba'i gnas su byon te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la gshegs pa'i tshe/ zhabs ni bskyod mi bskyod pa yang / /shin du rgyas pa'i pad steng gshegs / /'dab mar khru ni sum bcur bcas/ /bar gyi 'dab ma nyi shu lnga/ /ge sar nyi shu'i khru dang ldan/ /ze 'bru la ni bcu drug ste/ /ge sar kha dog shin du dmar/ /me tog pad mo chen po 'byung / /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i 'od zer 76—860

rab tu 'bar zhing gsal te nyi ma'i 'od kyang zhi)/ mi gsal zhing nyin mtshan bye brag med par 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe snga dro dang dgong mo bya'i sgras shes par byed pa dang ske/ me tog rgyas pas kyang 'jig rten pa rnams go bar byed do/ /gang dang gang na chos 'chad pa yod pa de dang der chos kyi sgra thams cad la rab tu grags shing 'chad par byed do/ /de'i tshe bram ze brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / tshangs pas ya phrag bco brgyad kyis thog mar chos kyi bdud rtsi 'thungs te/ 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das bsod nams dang byin rlabs brgya phrag mang po dang ldan pa 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa 'gyed cing / brgya phrag mang po'i mtshan can mtshan bzang po sum bcu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad bcu mnyam par ldan zhing ngo mtshar mang po mnga' ba/ brgya phrag mang po'i 'od de'i sku las 'byung ba yin no/ /ji ltar zhe na/ sngon po dang / ser po'i kha dog dang / dmar po'i kha dog dang / dkar po'i kha dog dang / shel gyi kha dog dang / dngul gyi kha dog gsal zhing gsal ba'i 'od zer dang bcas pa 'byung ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi sku de las 'od 'phro ba ta la'i shing lta bu phyogs thams cad du bskor zhing phung po so sor bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la lan gsum bskor ba byas shing yar mar 'gro bar byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das de'i sku khru brgyad bcu rtsa brgyad kyi srid dang ldan pa yin te/ zhabs kyi mthil nas pus mo'i bar la khru nyi shu rtsa gnyis sol/ /pus mo dang lte ba'i bar la khru nyi shu rtsa gnyis so/ /lte ba dang mgur gyi bar la khru nyi shu rtsa gnyis so/ /mgur dang dbu'i bar la khru nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o//dpung ba gnyis kyi bar la khru nyi shu lnga lnga'o/ /sgrog rus re re la'ang khru lnga lnga'o/ /snyan shal gnyis la khru bdun bdun no/ /spyan re re'i dkyus la khru lnga lnga'o/ /76—861

smin ma gnyis la'ang khru lnga lnga'o/ /smin phrag la'ang khru lnga'o/ /shangs kyi dkyus la khru bdun no/ /mchu gnyis la khru bcu'o/ /ljags kyi skor la khru lnga'o/ /gtsug tor la khru lnga'o/ /zhal gyi skor gser gyi me long lta bu la khru nyi shu rtsa lnga'o/ /mgrin pa la'ang khru lnga'o/ /phyag gnyis kyi dkyus la khru bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi 'byung ba yin no/ /de lta bu'i sangs rgyas de ni dpe med pa'i dpal dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan mtha' med pa dang ldan zhing / 'jig rten 'khor lo stong phrag bcu po thams cad kyi lha dang mi'i dbus su bzhugs nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing ston par mdzad pa yin no/ /de'i rjes su sa ya 'bum phrag gcig gi lha dang mi rnams 'dzin pa med par dang po nyid du chos kyi mchog gis rnam par grol ba thob par 'gyur te/ rnam par grol ba ma thob pa rnams lha'i yul du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /'di ltar byams pa legs pa'i mchog chen po de gang gis mi mthong zhe na/ ma bsad pa dang / pha bsad pa dang / dgra bcom pa bsad pa dang / dge slong ma sun phyung ba dang / dge 'dun gyi dbyen byed pa ste sdig pa'i las lnga byed pa dang / mchod rten bshig pa dang /byang chub kyi shing bcad pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gsod pa dang /dge 'dun gyi 'tsho ba nyams par byed pa dang / ser sna che ba dang / rtag chad du nges par lta ba'i mu stegs dang / 'phags pa rnams la smod pa dang /gcer bu ba'i rigs can rnams kyis mi mthong ba yin no/ /tshigs su bcad pa stong phrag gcig gi rgyan yod pa'i thams cad sgrol ba'i skyes rabs chen po stong phrag gsum pa zhag gcig la 'chad cing nyan par byed pa'i mi dang / mar me stong phrag gcig 'bul ba dang / dri bzang po med na yang me tog stong phrag 76—862

gcig tsam 'bul ba dang / ud pal sngon po stong phrag gcig tsam 'bul ba dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel yod pa'i mchod rten dang / sangs rgyas kyi sku la mchod pa byed pa thams cad ni sangs rgyas byams pa de chos 'chad pa'i dus su de'i drung du chos kyi mchog gis rnam par grol ba thob pa dang / mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de ma yin pa sems can sbyin pa gtong ba dang / sdom pa bsrung ba dang ske/ lha khang byed pa dang / byang chub kyi shing gi sa bon skyed pa dang / ring bsrel gyi mchod rten byed pa dang / byang chub kyi shing dang mchod rten la zhabs thog byed pa dang / sems can la phan pa'i tshal byed pa dang / zam pa byed pa dang ske/ lam 'chos pa dang / 'gron po'i gnas khang byed pa dang / chu mig byed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dad par byed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos 'di dag 'chad pa la dri dang me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa byed pa dang /khri la byi dor byed cing legs par chos nyan pa dang / dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur dam pa byed pa dang / ma dang pha'i zhabs thog byed pa dang / rigs kyis che ba la gus par byed pa dang / sdom pa srung ba'i dus su dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / chos brtswa lnga la dus ston byed pa dang / lhung zed 'bul ba dang / stan ster bar byed pa thams cad kyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byams pa mthong zhing mjal ba yin no/ /de lta bu'i bsod nams mang po mi nus na yang me rtog spar mo re tsam dang / mar me gcig tsam 'bul bar byed pa dang / gzhan gyi bsod nams la rjes su yid rang ba'i dge bar byed pa'i lha dang mi rnams kyi sa de'i dus na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byams pa mthong ba yin no/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byams 76—863

pa de mthong bar 'dod pa'i dad pa yod cing sbyin pa gtong ba dang / tshul khrims srung ba dang / bsnyen gnas sgrub pa dang / don yang dag par sgom pa dang ske/ dge ba'i las shin du legs par byed pa rnams kyis shin du legs par mthong ba yin no/ /thub pa'i gsung rab thos gyur nas/ /tshangs par spyod par sgrub byed pa/ /de rnams 'khor ba'i pha rol phyin/ /'chi med thar ba thob par 'gyur/ /tshangs spyod yang dag sgrub byed cing / /sbyin gnas mchog la sbyin byed dang / /bsnyen gnas bslab pa stsogs srung dang / /byams pa'i sgom la legs gnas pa/ /rtse gcig pa yis bsgrub par gyis/ /nyin mtshan bsod nams rab sgrub gyis/ /'di ru dag pa sgrub byed na/ /sdug bsngal zad par byed par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang bcas pa'i 'khor de dag thams cad yid rangs te0)ske/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa byams pa'i mdo rdzogs sto// //thub dbang mchog dang rgyal ba byams pa yi/ /bstan pa gsal byed mdo sde'i dbang po 'di/ /yon tan dang ldan sing ga gling yul gyi/ /stong phrag mang po'i dge 'dun kun gyi gtso/ /mar me mdzad slob rdo rje gdan bzhugs pa/ /paṇa chen ā nan da shrī yon tan can/ /dge slong chos kyi spyan can skad gnyis mkhas / /bstan la phan 'dod bzang po de nyid dang / /de'i legs gtugs dge slong lung rigs 'dzin/ /skad gnyis smra ba mchog gi rjes 'jug pa/ /kun dga' rgyal mtshan thub bstan dpal bzang pos/ /ston pa 'das nas lo stong brgyad brgya dang / /lnga bcu lhag pa'i zla ba bcu 'das dus/ /chos kyi rgyal 76—864

po ha shang mnga' gsol tshe/ /me lug dgun zla ra ba'i yar ngo la/ /dpal ldan bla ma kun dga' seng ge yi/ /sku drin la brten dpal ldan sa skyar ni/ /sgra don ji bzhin legs par bsgyur ba yin/ /'phags nor rgyan ldan skyes bu dam pa rnams/ /dam chos rin chen 'di la gtsug rgyan mdzod/ /nyon mongs nad can phrag dog rab rib can/ /chos sman 'di sten nad med mig gsal 'gyur/ /dge ba 'di gzhan ma lus legs bsdoms te/ /bla ma thub dbang byams pa mgon la sogs/ /sangs rgyas kun mnyes rnam dag rgya chen zhing / /rnam dag rab bsgrubs bstan pa mchog bsgrubs nas/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing rdul snyed kyi sprul pa yis / /sems can thams cad bstan la dad byas shing / /sangs rgyas bstan pa rab tu rgyas byas te/ /sangs rgyas sku gsum ye shes myur thob shog /shes bya mtha' yas rab tu zab phyir dang / /shes byed tshad can rab tu rtogs sla'i phyir//'khrul par gyur na rab tu sems dge ba'i phyir/ /skye bo mkhas rnams rab tu bzod mdzad rigs/ /rgya dpe dang legs par btugs so/ /phyogs dus thams cad du bkra shis dang bde legs kyis khyab par gyur cig/ //— 76—865

bsdur mchan/848 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/849 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉cig849 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉tshad/ ②〈〈zhol 〉〉srung / ni〈〈zhol 〉〉ma gyur pa/851 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉 du/ ②〈〈zhol 〉〉rim gyis/ ①〈〈zhol 〉〉ma gyur pa/ ④〈〈zhol 〉〉bskor/ ⑤〈〈zhol 〉〉bsgrags/yi〈〈zhol 〉〉lha skor/852 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉gsar pa'i/852 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉dwags/ ②〈〈zhol 〉〉las/855 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉rnying / ②〈〈zhol 〉〉de yi/ ③〈〈zhol 〉〉bzang /857 7〈〈zhol 〉〉sgyug858 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉dwags/86༷ hu)〈〈zhol 〉〉gdon/861 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉 kyang /864 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉yi rang ste/76wa 866
bsdur 'bras re'u migamado lde/ (272) — 76wa 867

༄tshon /rgya gar skad du/ ārya mi tri ya byā ka ra ṇa/ bod skad du/'phags pa byams pa lung bstan pa/ 'phags pa byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kyi sde dpon khyab bdag dpal/ /shes rab chen po shā ri'i bus/ /'jig rten rnams la snying brtse'i phyir/ /ston pa la ni yongs zhus pa/ /sngon dang phyi mtha'i mdo las ni/ /ma 'ongs pa'i (nakyisangs rgyas gang / /'jig rten 'dren par mdzad pa po/ /byams pa zhes bya bstan pa de/ /'dren pa bdag ni de'i mthu dang / /rdzu 'phrul dang ni don thams cad/ /rgyas par rab tu nyan 'tshal na / /de ni mi mchog bdag la gsungs/ /de la ston pas bka' stsal pa/ /sangs rgyas byams pa mi mchog de'i/ /'byor pa rgyas par khyod la ngas/ /lung bstan bya skres chang la nyon/ /de'i gatshe na rgya mtsho ni/ /khor yug tu ni dpag tshad brgya/ /skam par 'gyur te de yang ni/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i lam bzang 76—868

yin / /de tshe 'dzam bu'i gling 'di yang / /chu zheng thag gru mnyam par ni/ /dpag tshad stong phrag bcu pa ste/ /'byung po kun gyi gnas su 'gyur/ /de'i tshe na yul gyi mi/ /dar cing 'byor la chad pa med/ /'tshe med mi ni de dag kyang //dge ba byed pa dag tu 'gyur/ /sa gzhi tsher ma med pa dang / /mnyam zhing ne'u bsing sngo dang ldan/ /'phar zhing nems shes 0)byed pa ste/ /shing bal mdab ma bzhin du 'jam/ /mngar zhing dri ni zhim pa yi/ /sā lu ma rmos par skye'o / /sna tshogs tshon gyis mdzes byas pa'i/ /gos kyi ljon shing 'byung bar 'gyur / /me tog lo ma 'bras ldan pa'i/ /ljon shing 'phang du rgyang grags 'byung ske/ /de dag rnams kyi tshe lo ni/ /brgyad khri kho na thub par 'gyur/ /sems can de dag skyon med cing / /nyes bral spro ba che dang ldan/ /lus chen kha dog ldan pa ste/ /tshan po che yi stobs dang ldan/ /nad ni gsum zhig 'byung bar 'gyur/ /'dod dang mi za rga ba'o/ /bu mo lo ni lnga brgya dag /lon nas khyo la bag mar 'gro/ /de tshe tog ldan zhes bya ba'i/ /rgyal po'i pho brang 'byung 'gyur te/ /srog chags dge ba'i las byed pa'i/ /sems can rnams kyi gnas yin no/ /chur ni dpag tshad bcu gnyis te/ /rgyar ni dpag tshad bdun yod pa'i / /bsod nams byas pa rnam dag gi/ /grong khyer yid 'ong 'byung bar 'gyur / /rin chen bdun las byas mtho ba'i/ /ra ba 'phang du rgyang grags 'byung ske/ /shing thags dang ni sgo khang rnams/ /rin chen sna tshogs dag gis brgyan / /rin chen so phag gis brtsigs shing / /pad ma uta pal gcal du bkram / /ngur pas mdzes par byas pa yi/ /'obs kyang 'byung ba kho nar 'gyur / /khor yug tu ni ta la yi/ /phreng ba bdun gyis yongs su bskor/ /76—869

dril bu'i dra bas mdzes byas pa/ /rin chen bzhi rgyu'i ta la dag /rlung bskyod ta la de dag las/ /snyan pa'i sgra ni 'di ltar dper/ /sil snyan yan lag lnga ldan bzhin/ /de las yid 'ong sgra grag 'gyur/ /mi rnams gang dag grong khyer der / /rtse dga' bde don gnyer ba rnams/ /de dag ta la'i sgra de yis/ /rab tu mgu zhing rtsen par byed/ /ud pal ku mu das gang ba'i/ /rdzing bu dag kyang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /grong der ༅skyed mos tshal dang ni/ /nags tshal phun sum tshogs par 'gyur/ /der ni rung zhes bya ba yi/ /rgyal po gzi brjid che ldan zhing / /stobs che gling bzhi dbang phyug pa/ /mnga' bdag 'khor los sgyur na)ba 'byung / /dpung gi yan lag bzhi 'byor cing / /rin chen bdun dang yang dag ldan/ /rgyal po'i de'i sras rnams ni/ /stong du tshang bar 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mi yi dbang po de yang ni/ /sa 'di rgya mcho3re mtha' klas par/ /chad pa med cing chos dang ni/ /'thun pas yongs su skyong bar 'gyur/ /de tshe dung zhes bya ba'i/ /sa bdag rgyal po de la ni/ /rin chen khrag khrig brgyas mtshon pa'i/ /gter chen bzhi ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /su'i mtshan ni ser skya ste / /bcom brlag na ni dkar po yin/ /sa 'dzin na ni e la'i mdab/ /bā ra na se'i grong khyer dung / /gter ni bzhi po kho na dang / /rgyal po yang dag ldan par ni/ /'byung 'gyur dpa' bo chen po de/ /bsod nams brgya'i stobs las skyes/ /de tshe rgyal po'i na mdun na 'don/ /bram ze tshangs rab ces bya ba/ /thos mang rig byed bzhi 'don pa'i/ /mkhan po zhig ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /'don du 'jug dang gsang tshig 'dzin/ /dran ldan rig byed gzhung 'grel dang ske/ /sgra nges sbyor bcas pha rol phyin/ /brda sprod pa dang tshig dang ldan/ /76—870

de tshe de yi chung ma ni/ /tshangs ldan ma zhes bya ba ste/ /mdzes shing blta na sdug pa dang / /gzugs bzang hu)grags dang ldan pa 'byung / /byams pa gang zag mchog gyur pa/ /dga' ldan gnas nas shi 'phos nas/ /de tshe de'i lhums su ni / /nges par nying mtshams sbyor bar 'gyur/ /gzi brjid chen po zla ba bcu/ /tshang bar lhums su bzhugs nas kyang / /byams pa'i yum ni skyed mos tshal/ /me tog bzang rgyas nang gshegs nas/ /chos ston ma de mi 'dug cing / /mi nyal 'greng bzhin dag tu ni/ /shing gi yal ga la bzung nas/ /byams pa bltam ②pa nyid du 'gyur/ /mi yi mchog tu gyur pa de/ /glo g.yas nas ni 'byung 'gyur te/ /dper na sprin gyi phung po nas/ /nyi ma byung ba bzhin du gsal / /ji ltar chu yi pad ma bzhin/ /mngal gyi 'dam gyis mi gos so/ /khams gsum 'di ni thams cad du/ /'od kyis rgyas par 'gengs par 'gyur/ /de nas brgya byin lha dbang po/ /bde sogs mnga' bdag dga' 'gyur nas/ /byams pa rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /bltam pa'i tshe na lon par 'gyur/ /de ni bltam cham thag tu yang / /gom pa bdun dag 'dor bar 'gyur/ /gom pa re rer gter dang ni/ /pad ma re re 'byung bar 'gyur/ /phyogs bzhi dag tu gzigs nas ni/ /bdag gi skye ba tha ma ni/ /'di yin yang srid yod ma yin/ /yang dang yang du phyir mi 'ong / /zag med mya ngan 'das 'gro zhes/ /gsung yang rab tu bka' stsal to/ /klu rnams kyis ni chu yi rgyun/ /bsil dang 'jam pas sku bsil 'gyur/ /nam mkha'i ngos nas lha rdzas kyi/ /gos dang me tog 'bab par 'gyur/ /de'i dbu la gdugs dkar po/ /lha rnams kyis ni 'dzin par 'gyur/ /mtshan mchog sum bcu gnyis mnga' ba/ /byams pa dpal gyis 76—871

'bar ba de/ /ma mas yang dag blangs nas su/ /yum gyi phyag tu 'bul bar 'gyur / /rin chen sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i/ /khyogs ni yid du 'ong ba la /sras dang bcas par zhugs gsol nas/ /lha rnams kyis ni khyer bar 'gyur/ /sil snyan stong phrag du ma dag /sgra 'byin 'khrol ba'i grong khyer der/ /byams pa gshegs pa tsam gyis ni/ /me tog char pa 'bab par 'gyur/ /de'i nyin par sbrum pa yi/ /bud med rnams kyang btsa' 'gyur te/ /de dag thams cad nyams bde zhing / /bde legs su ni btsa' bar 'gyur/ /tshangs rab mtshan mchog sum bcu gnyis/ /ldan pa'i sras de mthong nas ni/ /gsang tshig dag la rab brtags nas/ /de'i 'og tu dga' bar 'gyur/ /ji ltar gsang tshig las 'byung bzhin/ /gzhon nu'i 'gro ba gnyis yin te/ /mi dbang 'khor los sgyur ba'am/ /sangs rgyas rkang gnyis mchog tu 'gyur/ /byams pa rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /dpal de na tshod rdzogs nas ni/ /skye dgu 'di ni sdug bsngal snyam / /chos kyi bdag nyid dgongs par mdzad/ /dbyangs che tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang ldan/ /'od che gser gyi mdog dang ldan/ /steng phel che zhing thal gong rgyas/ /pad ma'i mdab ma 'dra ba'i spyan/ /de'i sku'i khrun du ni/ /khru ni brgyad cu dag tu 'gyur/ /zheng ni khru rnams nyi shu ste/ /zhal gyi dkyil 'khor de yi byed/ /byams pa de ni bram ze'i bu/ /stong phrag bzhi po dag dang ni / /brgyad bcus mdun du bdar nas ni/ /gsang tshig dag kyang 'don du 'jug /de nas rgyal po chen po dung / /sboms su 'dom ni drug cu bzhi/ /'phang du 'dom ni stong yod pa'i/ /mchod sdong zhig ni 'dzugs par 'gyur/ /mi dbang de yis mchod sdong de/ /rin chen sna tshogs kyis brgyan nas/ /76—872

mchod sbyin gyis ni mdun drangs te/ /bram ze dag la rab tu 'bul/ /mchod sdong yid 'ong rin chen rgyu/ /de ni phul ma thag tu yang / /bram ze stong bo rnams kyis ni/ /de'i mod la bged par gyur/ /byams pas mchod sdong de yi ni / /mi rtag nyid du mthong nas kyang / /'khor ba mtha' dag rnams bsams te / /rab tu 'byung bar 'dod par 'gyur/ /'dir bdag rab tu byung nas ni / /bdud rtsi'i 'phang reg 'gyur dang / /skye bo 'chi bdag nad rga ba'i/ /'jigs las 'grol bar 'gyur snyam zhes/ /skye bo rab dang gzigs nas ni/ /sdug bsngal sdug bsngal kun 'byung dang / /sdug bsngal yang dag 'ong ba dang / /bde ba mya ngan las 'das 'gro/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad pa yi/ /bden pa dag kyang ston par 'gyur/ /de'i chos de thos nas kyang / /bstan pa la ni nan tan sgrub/ /byams pa gang zag mchog gyur te/ /stong phrag bzhi po dag dang ni/ /brgyad bcu dag gis mdun bdar nas/ /rab tu 'byung bar nges 'byung 'gyur/ /de tshe de yi byang chub shing / /klu shing zhes bya 'byung 'gyur te / /de'i yal ga gnam 'phang du/ /dpag tshad tsam du yang dag 'phags/ /de ni byang chub shing de'i/ /yal ga gel pa thams cad du/ /kho ra khor yug rgyang grags drug /khebs pa kho na dag tu 'gyur/ /byams pa rkang gnyis mchog gyur de/ /de'i drung du gshegs nas su/ /bla med byang chub zhi ba ni/ /'thob 'gyur 'di la the com med/ /gang gi nub mo kho na la/ /rab tu 'byung bar mngon 'byung ba/ /de ni nub mo kho na la/ /byang chub dam pa 'thob par 'gyur / /de yi 'og tu thub mchog de/ /dam chos sdug bsngal kun spong zhing / /zhi ba yan lag brgyad ldan pa'i/ /gsung gis ston par mdzad par 'gyur/ /76—873

me tog mdzes pa rgyus 11pa yi/ /skyed mos tshal du de'i 'khor/ /dpag tshad rgya khyon gang ba dag /yang dag 'du ba kho nar 'gyur/ /de nas mi dbang rgyal po dung ske/ /grags pa chen pos thos nas ni/ /sbyin pa grangs med byas nas kyang / /rab tu 'byung bar 'dod par 'gyur/ /rgyal po stong phrag bzhi dang ni/ /brgyad bcu dag gis mdun bdar te/ /khyim nas nges par byung nas ni/ /rab tu 'byung bar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /byams pa'i yab kyang de bzhin du/ /de'i tshad dang mnyam pa'i/ /bram ze rnams kyis mdun bdar nas/ /rab tu 'byung bar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de nas de tshe khyim bdag ni/ /nor bzang tshogs ni rnam grags pa/ /chos kyi bdag nyid stong dag gis/ /bskor nas rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dung gi bud med rin po che/ /sa ga zhes ni rnam grags pa/ /bud med stong phrag bzhi dang ni/ /brgyad bcu dag gis mdun bdar te/ /de yi 'og tu mngon byung nas/ /rab tu 'byung bar 'gro bar 'gyur / /de yi tshe na byams pa yi/ /bstan pa la ni srog chags dag /stong phrag dang ni brgya phrag rnams/ /rab tu 'byung bar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de'i 'og tu thugs rje can/ /ston pa byams pa rkang gnyis mchog /'khor la rnam par gzigs nas ni/ /shakya seng ge thub pa ste/ /gtso bo skyob par mdzad pa po / /dam pa'i chos dbyings gzigs gyur pa/ /'jig rten mgon pos 'di dag kun/ /thar pa'i lam de bskyed nas kyang / /don gyis nga yi bstan la btang ske/ /gdugs dang rgyan mtshan ba dan dang / /dri dang phreng ba byug pa yisal/ /shākya thub la mchod nas ni/ /nga yi bstan la lhags pa yin/ /gur gum chu yis gdab pa dang / /tsan dan gyi ni byug pa yis/ /shākya thub pa'i 76—874

mchod rten la/ /mchod nas nga yi bstan la lhags/ /de tshe sangs rgyas chos dang ni/ /dge 'dun la yang skyabs song shing / /dge ba'i las kyang byas nas ni / /nga yi bstan la lhags pa yin/ /shākya seng ge'i bstan pa la/ /bslab gzhi yang dag blangs nas su/ /ji ltar gsung bzhin bsgrubs nas ni/ /nga'i bstan la lhags pa yin/ /dge 'dun la yang chos gos dang / /zhal zas dang ni btung ba dang / /snyun gsos sna tshogs sbyin pa rnams/ /phul nas nga yi bstan la lhags/ /bcu bzhi dang ni brtswa lnga dang / /de bzhin zla gcig tshes brgyad dang / /cho 'phrul wa yi zla ba la/ /yan lag brgyad legs mnyam bzhag cing ske/ /bsnyen gnas gso sbyong byas nas ni/ /nga yi bstan la lhags so zhes/ /don 'di rab tu gsung bar 'gyur/ /de yi nyan thos rnams kyang ni/ /cho 'phrul gsum gyis 'dul bar 'gyur/ /de tshe de dag thams cad ni/ /zag zad 'grogs na bde bar 'gyur/ /de'i 'dus pa dang po ni/ /nyan thos srid pa bcad gyur pa/ /dung phyur phrag dgu bye phrag drug /tshang ba'i nyan thos 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de'i 'dus pa gnyis pa ni/ /nyon mongs 'ching ba las grol ba'i/ /dung phyur phrag dgu bye phrag bzhi/ /tshang ba'i nyan thos 'byung bar 'gyur / /de yi 'dus pa gsum pa ni/ /sems zhi rnam par grol gyur pa/ /dung phyur phrag dgu bye phrag gnyis/ /tshang ba'i nyan thos 'byung bar 'gyur/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor nas/ /lha dang mi rnams rnam btul te/ /nyan thos dge 'dun thabs gcig tu/ /grong du bsod snyoms spyod la rgyu/ /de nas rtog ldan dga' lta yi/ /grong khyer der ni gshegs pa na/ /grong khyer mchog tu man dhā ra'i/ /me tog char chen 'bab par 'gyur/ /thub pa grong der 76—875

gshegs pa la/ /lha yis me tog 'thor bar 'gyur/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi dag dang ske/ /brgya byin sum cu rtsa gsum dbang / /tshangs pa lha tshogs thabs gcig tu / /de la mchod pa byed par 'gyur/ /lha'i bu ni mthu chen gyis/ /ud pal pad ma ku mu ta/ /pad ma dkar po dri zhim dang / /a ka ru dang tsan dan dang ske/ /de bzhin lha rdzas phreng ba dang / /lha rdzas gos kyang 'thor bar 'gyur/ /'jig rten mgon de grong khyer gyi/ /mchog tu gshegs pa mthong nas ni/ /shing bal mdab ltar 'jam pa yi/ /sa der gding ba rgya cher 'dings①/ /de dag lam kur phreng ba ni/ /sna tshogs mdzes pa rnam par 'grems②/ /lha'i bu ni mthu chen dang / /mi rnams yid ni rab dang ba/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang / /spos dang phreng ba byug pa dang / /rol mo sgra snyan bsgrags pa yis / /ston pa la ni mchod par 'gyur/ /brgya byin mig stong lha rnams kyi/ /rgyal po bde sogs bdag po de/ /rab mgu thal mo sbyar nas ni/ /'jig rten mgon la bstod par byed/ /skyes bu cang shes khyod la 'dud/ /skyes mchog khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zag mchog gyur bcom ldan 'das/ /skye dgu la ni thugs brtser mdzod/ /de'i tshe na lha'i bu/ /mthu chen bdud ces bya ba 'byung ske/ /de yang thal mo rab sbyar nas/ /'jig rten mgon la bstod par byed / /tshangs pa'i 'khor gyis yongs bskor cing / /tshangs pas kyang ni mdun bdar te/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs ni sgrog bzhin du/ /dam pa'i chos ni gsung bar 'gyur/ /zag zad nyes pa rnams bral zhing / /srid pa'i 'ching ba rab spangs pa'i/ /dgra bcom rnams kyis sa 'di ni/ /thams cad kun du gang bar 'gyur/ /lha dang mi dang dri za dang / /gnod sbyin dang ni srin po klu/ /76—876

mthu chen rnams ni mgu gyur nas/ /ston la mchod pa byed par 'gyur/ /gang dag byams pa'i bstan pa la/ /tshangs par spyad pa spyod gyur pa/ /de dag gdon mi za bar ni/ /nyon mongs med cing the tsom med/ /gang dag byams pa'i bstan pa la/ /tshangs par spyad pa spyod 'gyur ba/ /de dag gdon mi za bar ni/ /nga yi med cing yongs 'dzin med/ /gser dang dngul la 'dzin med cing / /gnas med chags pa'ang yod pa min/ /gang dag byams pa'i bstan pa la/ /tshangs par spyad pa spyod 'gyur ba/ /de dag gdon mi za bar ni / /sred pa'i dra ba gcad 1)pa dang / /bsam gtan rdzogs par byas nas ni/ /dga' dang bde dang yang dag ldan/ /'byung po kun la thugs brtse ba /byams pa rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog /lo ni drug khri dag tu yang / /dam pa'i chos ni ston par 'gyur/ /de na srog chags brgya stong dang / /'bum phrag rnam par 'dren pa ste/ /dam pa'i chos la btul nas ni/ /de nas mya ngan 'da' bar 'gyur/ /thub pa chen pos gsungs pa de/ /yongs su mya ngan 'das nas kyang ske/ /de tshe de'i dam chos ni/ /lo khri dag tu gnas par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba shākya thub de la/ /sems ni reb tu dad par gyis/ /des ni byams pa rkang gnyis mchog /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mthong bar 'gyur/ /de phyir sangs rgyas chos dag dang / /dge 'dun tshogs kyi mchog la ni/ /sems ni rab tu dad gyis dang / /don chen rab tu 'grub par 'gyur/ /thugs rje che ldan de lta bu'i / /byams pa rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /de tshe mnyes par byas nas ni/ /de nas mya ngan 'da' bar 'gyur/ /ya mtshan 'di dag thos gyur cing / /'byor pa mi nyung mthong mdzad de/ /nag po'i rigs kyang dad 'gyur na/ /76—877

mkhas pa su zhig dad mi 'gyur/ /de phyir 'di na bdag nyid che/ /'dod cing bdag la legs 'dod pas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dran bzhin tu/ /dam pa'i chos la gus par bya/ /'phags pa byams pa lung bstan pa rdzogs sto/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / lotstsha ba ban dhe dpal brtsegs rakṣi tas bsgyur/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā/ he turnye ṣānta thā ga to hya ba data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha/ e ba'i dī ma hā shra ma ṇa/①bsdur ma na/867 0mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈zhol 〉〉pa yi/ ②〈〈zhol 〉〉yi/④〈〈zhol 〉〉de yi/868 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉nem zhes/869 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉de/ ②〈〈zhol 〉〉bsgyur/ sa〈〈zhol 〉〉de'i/87 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉mthong / ② 0〈〈zhol 〉〉bltams/872 0)〈〈zhol 〉〉brgyus/875 4)〈〈zhol 〉〉'ding / ②〈〈zhol 〉〉'grem/876 ①〈〈zhol 〉〉bcad/877 6)〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉 ye dharmā he tu tha ma ṇa/ 76wa 878
